const S = D.stats;
const MG = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("minigames.json", "utf8"));
const MGG = Object.fromEntries(MG.games.map((g) => [g[0], g]));
const MGP = {}; for (const [code, pl] of Object.entries(MG.placement)) for (const [sid, L, g, why] of pl) MGP[`${sid}:${L}`] = { g, why };
const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, WidthType, ShadingType, BorderStyle,
  HeadingLevel, PageOrientation, AlignmentType, Footer, PageNumber, PageBreak } = require("docx");
const W = 13680;
const bd = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "B7C3CC" };
const borders = { top: bd, bottom: bd, left: bd, right: bd };
const kids = [];
const add = (...x) => x.flat().forEach((y) => kids.push(y));

const H1n = (t) => new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, children: [new TextRun(t)] });
const H2 = (t) => new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, children: [new TextRun(t)] });
const H3 = (t) => new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_3, children: [new TextRun(t)] });
const RCOL = { BEST: "1E7B45", OKAY: "6B6B00", RISKY: "B35900", WORST: "B3261E" };
let tno = 0;
function T(title, headers, rows, fr, opts = {}) {
  const tot = fr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const widths = fr.map((f) => Math.floor(W * f / tot));
  widths[widths.length - 1] += W - widths.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const size = opts.size || 17;
  const cell = (v, i, head, shade, fill) => {
    const runs = (Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]).map((x) => typeof x === "object" && x !== null ? new TextRun({ size, font: "Arial", ...x }) : new TextRun({ text: String(x ?? ""), size, font: "Arial", bold: head, color: head ? "FFFFFF" : "1A1A1A" }));
    return new TableCell({ borders, width: { size: widths[i], type: WidthType.DXA },
      shading: head ? { fill: "1F2F3D", type: ShadingType.CLEAR, color: "auto" } : fill ? { fill, type: ShadingType.CLEAR, color: "auto" } : shade ? { fill: "EEF2F5", type: ShadingType.CLEAR, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: 80, right: 80 }, children: [new Paragraph({ children: runs })] });
  };
  const out = [];
  if (title) { tno += 1; out.push(new Paragraph({ keepNext: true, spacing: { before: 160, after: 60 }, children: [new TextRun({ text: `Table ${tno}. ${title}`, bold: true, size: 19, color: "C25E00" })] })); }
  out.push(new Table({ width: { size: W, type: WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: widths,
    rows: [new TableRow({ tableHeader: true, children: headers.map((h, i) => cell(h, i, true)) }),
      ...rows.map((r, k) => new TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: (r.cells || r).map((v, i) => cell(v, i, false, k % 2 === 1, r.cells ? r.fill : undefined)) }))] }));
  out.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, children: [] }));
  return out;
}
const pctFmt = (n, d) => `${n} of ${d}`;

// ----- per city
function effects(o) {
  if (o.effects_text) return o.effects_text;
  const parts = [`injury ${o.injury_chance}% (−${o.damage})`, `${o.hours} h`];
  const sup = [["food", o.food], ["water", o.water], ["health", o.heal]].filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k, v]) => `${v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${v} ${k}`);
  if (sup.length) parts.push(sup.join(", "));
  if (o.fuel >= 25) parts.push("fills the fuel tank"); else if (o.fuel) parts.push(`${o.fuel > 0 ? "+" : ""}${o.fuel} gal fuel`);
  if (o.hours_saved) parts.push(`saves ${o.hours_saved} h driving`);
  if (o.vehicle) parts.push(`vehicle ${o.vehicle}`);
  if (o.miles) parts.push(`+${o.miles} miles`);
  if (o.sets_flag) parts.push(`sets ${o.sets_flag}`);
  if (o.requires_flag) parts.push(`needs ${o.requires_flag}`);
  return parts.join("; ");
}

import json, csv, re, sys, copy, collections
import os; ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))); sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
from zombie_sim.data_loader import load_world
from handwritten import FLAGS, COND, COND_RULES, GATES, GATE_CHECK, SHARED

W = load_world()
C = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "content", "scenarios.json")))
A = {r["option_key"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "content", "option_attributes.csv")))}
ORDER = ["BEST", "OKAY", "RISKY", "WORST"]
SUPPLY_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(search|raid|grab|loot|food|supplies|store|cafeteria|houses|cabins|trucks|motel|buildings|mall|cooler|snacks)\b", re.I)
TRAP_APPEAL = re.compile(r"\b(help|shelter|warm|hospital|stadium|join|fast|faster|quick|straight|jump|swim|soak|drink|save time|mall|crowd|music|survivors|helicopter|race car|boat|demand|threaten|floor it|speed)\b", re.I)
TEMPT = re.compile(r"\b(steal|take|grab|raid|sneak|ride|drive|keep driving|run|force|push|climb|break|walk|try|go)\b", re.I)
GEM_TIMID = re.compile(r"\b(slow|slowly|wait|skip|walk|stay|back up|calmly|honest|give|decline|hand over|respect|follow their rules|distract|bypass|other bridge|outer loop)\b", re.I)

def stop_normal(code, sid, day, time):
    stops = W["routes"][code]
    if day is None:
        return None, None
    a = day - 1
    b = a if time == "Morning" else min(day, 7)
    if sid.endswith("07N"):
        a = b = 7
    s1, s2 = W["stations"][stops[a]["station"]], W["stations"][stops[b]["station"]]
    label = stops[a]["label"] if a == b else f"between {stops[a]['label']} and {stops[b]['label']}"
    return (s1["tavg_f"] + s2["tavg_f"]) / 2, label

def opt_metrics(o):
    return (o["injury_chance"] * o["damage"] / 100.0, o["hours"], o.get("food", 0) + o.get("water", 0) + o.get("heal", 0), o["fuel"])

def dominated_one(a, others):
    ma = opt_metrics(a)
    for b in others:
        mb = opt_metrics(b)
        if mb[0] <= ma[0] and mb[1] <= ma[1] and mb[2] >= ma[2] and mb[3] >= ma[3] and mb != ma:
            return True
    return False

def dominated(opts):
    n = 0
    for a in opts:
        ma = opt_metrics(a)
        for b in opts:
            if a is b: continue
            mb = opt_metrics(b)
            if mb[0] <= ma[0] and mb[1] <= ma[1] and mb[2] >= ma[2] and mb[3] >= ma[3] and mb != ma:
                n += 1; break
    return n

out = {"cities": [], "shared": SHARED, "cond_rules": COND_RULES, "gate_check": GATE_CHECK}
stats = collections.Counter()
weather_rows = []
for city in C["cities"]:
    code = city["code"]
    stops = W["routes"][code]
    c0 = W["counties"][stops[0]["geoid"]]; st0 = W["stations"][stops[0]["station"]]
    profile = re.sub(r"\(about [\d,]+ people per square mile\)", f"({c0['name']}: about {c0['density']:,.0f} people per square mile, 2023 Census)", city["profile"])
    profile = re.sub(r"\(about (\d+)°F\)", f"(January normal {st0['tavg_f']:.1f}°F, NOAA)", profile)
    profile = re.sub(r"\((\d+)°F\)", f"(January normal {st0['tavg_f']:.1f}°F, NOAA)", profile)
    flagmap = {(f[0], f[1]): f for f in FLAGS[code]}
    payoffs = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for f in FLAGS[code]:
        payoffs[f[4]].append(f)
    conds = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for cnd in COND[code]:
        conds[cnd[0]].append(cnd)
    scenes = []
    groups = [("main", city["scenarios"]), ("detour", city["branches"]), ("callback", city["callbacks"])]
    for kind, lst in groups:
        for s in lst:
            s2 = {k: s[k] for k in s if k != "options"}
            s2["kind"] = kind
            day, tm = s.get("day"), s.get("time")
            normal, place = stop_normal(code, s["id"], day, tm) if kind == "main" else (None, None)
            s2["normal_f"], s2["place"] = normal, place
            # weather correction
            notes = []
            for m in re.finditer(r"(-?\d+)\s?°F", s["title"] + " " + s["text"]):
                t = int(m.group(1))
                if (t > 60 and "water" in s["text"].lower()) or "stays about" in s["text"]: continue  # water/cave temperature, not air
                if normal is not None and abs(t - normal) > 15:
                    notes.append(f"{t}°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is {normal:.1f}°F (NOAA 1991-2020).")
                    weather_rows.append([s["id"], f"{t}°F", f"{normal:.1f}°F", "Labeled as a record storm"])
                elif normal is not None:
                    weather_rows.append([s["id"], f"{t}°F", f"{normal:.1f}°F", "Close to normal; kept"])
                else:
                    notes.append(f"{t}°F is a fictional storm (detour/callback scenes have no fixed stop).")
                    weather_rows.append([s["id"], f"{t}°F", "—", "Labeled as a fictional storm"])
            if "1,968 miles" in s["text"]:
                notes.append("Mileage corrected to 2,230 road miles (OSRM).")
            s2["weather_note"] = " ".join(dict.fromkeys(notes))
            opts = []
            for o in s["options"]:
                a = A[f"{s['id']}:{o['letter']}"]
                o2 = {"letter": o["letter"], "text": o["text"], "why": o["note"], "rating": o["rating"], "looks": o.get("looks") or "",
                      "injury_chance": o["injury_chance"], "damage": o["damage"], "food": o.get("food", 0), "water": o.get("water", 0),
                      "heal": o.get("heal", 0), "hours": float(a["hours"]), "fuel": float(a["fuel_gal"]), "vehicle": a["vehicle"],
                      "miles": float(a["miles_bonus"]), "sets_flag": o.get("sets_flag") or "", "requires_flag": o.get("requires_flag") or "",
                      "alt": o.get("alt"), "setting": a["setting"], "activity": a["activity"], "changes": []}
                explicit_time = "h:" in a["evidence"] and "+" in a["evidence"]
                opts.append((o2, explicit_time))
            before = dominated([o for o, _ in opts])
            if s["id"] not in GATES and kind != "callback":
                ol = [o for o, _ in opts]
                for o in ol:
                    if dominated_one(o, [x for x in ol if x is not o]): stats["dom_before_" + o["rating"]] += 1
            is_gate = s["id"] in GATES
            if not is_gate and kind != "callback":
                for o, explicit in opts:
                    r = o["rating"]
                    if r == "BEST":
                        if o["food"] > 20 or o["water"] > 20:
                            o["changes"].append(f"supplies capped at 20 each (was food {o['food']}, water {o['water']}): you can only carry so much")
                            o["food"], o["water"] = min(o["food"], 20), min(o["water"], 20)
                            stats["best_capped"] += 1
                        target = 2.0 if (o["food"] or o["water"] or o["heal"]) else 1.5
                        if o["hours"] < target and not (o["vehicle"] == "gained" or o["miles"]):
                            o["changes"].append(f"time {o['hours']:g} h -> {target:g} h: the careful way is slower")
                            o["hours"] = target; stats["best_slower"] += 1
                    elif r == "RISKY":
                        if o["food"] + o["water"] == 0 and o["activity"] in ("scavenge", "contact") and SUPPLY_WORDS.search(o["text"]):
                            o["food"], o["water"] = 15, 10
                            o["changes"].append("risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water")
                            stats["risky_pays"] += 1
                        if not explicit and o["hours"] > 0.5:
                            o["changes"].append(f"time {o['hours']:g} h -> 0.5 h: the fast option")
                            o["hours"] = 0.5
                        if not explicit and o["activity"] == "travel" and o["setting"] != "open":
                            o["changes"].append("saves 2 h of driving: the fast option")
                            o["hours_saved"] = 2.0; stats["risky_fast"] += 1
                    elif r == "OKAY":
                        if not explicit and o["hours"] > 1.0:
                            o["changes"].append(f"time {o['hours']:g} h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one")
                            o["hours"] = 1.0
                        if explicit and o["hours"] >= 3:
                            rest = min(15, 5 * int(o["hours"] // 6))
                            o["changes"].append(f"slow but safest: keeps its {o['hours']:g} h story delay, injury chance {o['injury_chance']}% -> 5%" + (f", +{rest} health from rest" if rest else ""))
                            o["injury_chance"] = min(o["injury_chance"], 5); o["heal"] = o["heal"] + rest
                            stats["okay_safest"] += 1
            # weather-adjusted rating
            if kind == "main" and normal is not None and not is_gate:
                for o, _ in opts:
                    indoorish = re.search(r"\b(home|armory|houses|pharmacy|trucks)\b", o["text"], re.I)
                    onfoot = re.search(r"\b(walk|on foot|hike|climb|swim|ski|sleep under|camp)\b", o["text"], re.I)
                    outdoors = not indoorish and o["setting"] == "open" and (o["activity"] in ("scavenge", "contact", "social", "shelter") or re.search(r"\b(walk|on foot|hike|climb|swim|ski|sleep under|camp)\b", o["text"], re.I))
                    if outdoors and o["hours"] >= 0.5 and o["rating"] in ("OKAY", "RISKY"):
                        i = ORDER.index(o["rating"])
                        if normal <= 25:
                            o["weather_rating"] = ORDER[min(3, i + 1)]; stats["weather_worse"] += 1
                        elif normal >= 40 and onfoot:
                            o["weather_rating"] = ORDER[i - 1]; stats["weather_better"] += 1
            # traps and gems where the scene has none
            if not any(o["looks"] for o, _ in opts) and not is_gate:
                for o, _ in opts:
                    if o["rating"] == "WORST" and TRAP_APPEAL.search(o["text"]):
                        o["looks"] = "trap"; o["changes"].append("tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly"); stats["new_trap"] += 1; break
                else:
                  for o, _ in opts:
                    if o["rating"] == "WORST" and TEMPT.search(o["text"]):
                        o["looks"] = "trap"; o["changes"].append("tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly"); stats["new_trap"] += 1; break
                  else:
                    for o, _ in opts:
                        if o["rating"] == "BEST" and GEM_TIMID.search(o["text"]):
                            o["looks"] = "hidden_gem"; o["changes"].append("tagged HIDDEN GEM: sounds timid or slow, works best"); stats["new_gem"] += 1; break
            # flags set
            for o, _ in opts:
                f = flagmap.get((s["id"], o["letter"]))
                if f:
                    o["sets_flag"] = (o["sets_flag"] + ", " if o["sets_flag"] else "") + f[2]
                    o["changes"].append(f"now also sets {f[2]}: {f[3]}")
            if is_gate:
                newopts = []
                for (L, t, r, lk, eff, why) in GATES[s["id"]]:
                    newopts.append(({"letter": L, "text": t, "rating": r, "looks": lk, "effects_text": eff, "why": why, "changes": ["rewritten final-gate option"]}, False))
                opts = newopts
                s2["gate_check"] = GATE_CHECK
            s2["options"] = [o for o, _ in opts]
            s2["unlocked"] = [{"flag": f[2], "text": f[5], "rating": f[6], "effects_text": f[7], "why": f[8], "from": f[0]} for f in payoffs.get(s["id"], [])]
            s2["conditional"] = [{"when": c[1], "text": c[2], "rating": c[3], "effects_text": c[4], "why": c[5]} for c in conds.get(s["id"], [])]
            if not is_gate:
                after = dominated(s2["options"])
                for o in s2["options"]:
                    others = [x for x in s2["options"] if x is not o]
                    if dominated([o] + others) and dominated_one(o, others): stats["dom_after_" + o["rating"]] += 1
                if kind == "main":
                    stats["dom_before"] += before; stats["dom_after"] += after
            scenes.append(s2)
    out["cities"].append({"code": code, "start": city["start"], "end": city["end"], "route": city["route"], "miles": round(stops[-1]["cum_mi"]),
                          "profile_old": city["profile"], "profile": profile, "scenes": scenes,
                          "flags": [{"scene": f[0], "letter": f[1], "flag": f[2], "gets": f[3], "payoff_scene": f[4], "payoff": f[5]} for f in FLAGS[code]],
                          "conds": [{"scene": c[0], "when": c[1], "text": c[2]} for c in COND[code]]})
# looks coverage
cov = sum(1 for c in out["cities"] for s in c["scenes"] if s["kind"] == "main" and any(o.get("looks") for o in s["options"]))
stats["looks_coverage"] = cov
seen = set(); wr = []
for r in weather_rows:
    if tuple(r) not in seen: seen.add(tuple(r)); wr.append(r)
out["weather_rows"] = wr
out["stats"] = dict(stats)
json.dump(out, open("revised.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
print(dict(stats))
print(len(weather_rows))

FILE: tests/browser_playthrough.py

"""Plays the web game in headless Chrome: full trips on every route, checks for page errors, screenshots."""
import os, sys, threading, http.server, functools, json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WEB = os.path.join(ROOT, "web")
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "reports", "screenshots")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)


def serve():
    h = functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=WEB)
    h.log_message = lambda *a: None
    srv = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8765), h)
    threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    return srv


def main():
    srv = serve()
    errors, results = [], []
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.launch(executable_path=os.environ.get("CHROME") or None)
        page = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
        page.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
        page.on("console", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" and "ERR_TUNNEL" not in m.text and "fonts" not in m.text else None)
        cities = ["NYC", "BOS", "PIT", "SLC", "JAC", "SEA", "AUS"]
        for ci, code in enumerate(cities):
            page.goto("http://127.0.0.1:8765/index.html")
            page.evaluate("() => { window.__ZE_SIM_MINIGAMES = true; return 1; }")
            page.fill("#seed", str(100 + ci))
            if ci == 1:   # one route in developer mode
                page.fill("#devpw", "$@lt3d_Butter"); page.click("#devgo")
                assert "ON" in page.locator("#devstate").inner_text()
            if ci == 0:
                page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(OUT, "title.png"), full_page=True)
            page.locator(".city").nth(ci).click()
            shots = 0
            enters = 0
            for step in range(400):
                if page.locator("table.mc").count() and "Running" not in page.locator(".end .hint").first.inner_text():
                    if page.locator("#mcchart").count():
                        break
                opt = page.locator("button.opt:not([disabled])")
                if opt.count():
                    if ci == 1 and shots == 0:
                        shots = 0
                    if ci in (0, 1) and shots == 0:
                        page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(OUT, "scene.png" if ci == 0 else "scene_dev.png"), full_page=True); shots += 1
                    opt.nth(step % opt.count()).click()
                    page.wait_for_timeout(320)
                    continue
                btn = page.locator("#screen button.btn:not(.ghost)")
                if btn.count():
                    if ci in (0, 1) and shots == 1 and page.locator(".tiles").count() and page.locator(".outcome-head").count():
                        page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(OUT, "dashboard.png" if ci == 0 else "dashboard_dev.png"), full_page=True); shots += 1
                    if ci == 0 and page.locator("#outbreak:not(.hidden)").count() and "ended" not in btn.first.inner_text().lower():
                        errors.append("SEIR panel visible during player-mode play")
                    btn.first.click()
                    continue
                page.wait_for_timeout(150)
            page.wait_for_selector("#mcchart", timeout=60000)
            ending = page.locator(".end h2").inner_text()
            surv = page.locator("table.mc tr").nth(1).inner_text()
            results.append((code, ending, surv.replace("\t", " ")))
            if ci == 0:
                page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(OUT, "end.png"), full_page=True)
        b.close()
    srv.shutdown()
    for r in results:
        print(*r)
    print("page errors:", errors or "none")
    return 1 if errors or len(results) != 7 else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

// Runs the JavaScript engine for a list of (city, seed, policy) and prints JSON results.
const fs = require("fs"), path = require("path");
const Z = require(path.join(__dirname, "..", "web", "sim.js"));
const B = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const cases = JSON.parse(process.argv[2]);
(async () => {
  const out = [];
  for (const [city, seed, pol] of cases) {
    const g = await Z.playOne(B, city, seed, Z.POLICIES[pol]);
    const s = g.summary();
    out.push({ history: g.history, ending: s.ending, hours: s.hours, health: s.health, food: s.food, water: s.water,
      fuel: s.fuel, miles: s.miles, minigames: s.minigames, strength: s.strength, events: s.events,
      traj: g.traj.map((t) => t.at(9.3)) });
  }
  console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
})();

FILE: tests/test_data.py

import csv, os, shutil
import pytest
from zombie_sim.data_loader import load_world, DataValidationError, DATA_DIR, SQ_M_PER_SQ_MI


def test_world_loads_and_validates():
    w = load_world()
    assert len(w["routes"]) == 7
    assert all(len(stops) == 8 for stops in w["routes"].values())


def test_density_is_calculated_from_population_and_land_area():
    c = load_world()["counties"]["36061"]          # New York County
    assert c["population"] == 1597451
    assert c["density"] == pytest.approx(1597451 / (58683887 / SQ_M_PER_SQ_MI))
    assert 65000 < c["density"] < 75000


def test_route_distances_are_osrm_legs():
    stops = load_world()["routes"]["NYC"]
    assert stops[-1]["cum_mi"] == pytest.approx(3619019.6 / 1609.344, rel=1e-9)
    for code, s in load_world()["routes"].items():
        assert 2000 < s[-1]["cum_mi"] < 2500, code


def test_missing_snow_is_kept_as_missing_not_zero():
    st = load_world()["stations"]
    assert st["USW00024022"]["snow_in"] is None     # Laramie: NOAA publishes no January snow normal
    assert st["USW00023169"]["snow_in"] == 0.0      # Las Vegas: a real 0.0 normal


def test_station_used_for_each_stop_is_close_or_documented():
    for code, stops in load_world()["routes"].items():
        for s in stops:
            assert s["station_distance_mi"] < 150, (code, s["label"], s["station_distance_mi"])


def _copy_data(tmp_path):
    d = tmp_path / "data"
    shutil.copytree(DATA_DIR, d)
    return d


def _edit(path, fn):
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(path)))
    fn(rows)
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field,value,expect", [
    ("pop_estimate_2023", "", "missing value"),
    ("pop_estimate_2023", "-5", "positive"),
    ("land_area_sq_m", "0", "land area must be positive"),
    ("state_name", "Texas", "does not match"),
    ("geoid", "123", "5 digits"),
])
def test_bad_county_values_are_rejected(tmp_path, field, value, expect):
    d = _copy_data(tmp_path)
    _edit(d / "city_data.csv", lambda rows: rows[0].__setitem__(field, value))
    with pytest.raises(DataValidationError) as e:
        load_world(str(d))
    assert expect in str(e.value)


def test_missing_temperature_is_an_error_not_zero(tmp_path):
    d = _copy_data(tmp_path)
    _edit(d / "weather_data.csv", lambda rows: rows[0].__setitem__("jan_tavg_normal_f", ""))
    with pytest.raises(DataValidationError, match="January temperature: missing"):
        load_world(str(d))


def test_unknown_county_in_route_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    d = _copy_data(tmp_path)
    _edit(d / "route_data.csv", lambda rows: rows[0].__setitem__("county_geoid", "99999"))
    with pytest.raises(DataValidationError, match="not in city_data.csv"):
        load_world(str(d))


def test_missing_file_is_reported(tmp_path):
    d = _copy_data(tmp_path)
    os.remove(d / "weather_data.csv")
    with pytest.raises(DataValidationError, match="Missing data file"):
        load_world(str(d))

import math
import pytest
from zombie_sim.sim import play, assets, SimUI
from zombie_sim.engine import Game, ENDINGS
from zombie_sim.policies import POLICIES
from zombie_sim.params import PARAMS, MINIGAMES
from zombie_sim.rng import Mulberry32, Streams

CITIES = ["NYC", "BOS", "PIT", "SLC", "JAC", "SEA", "AUS"]


def new_game(city="NYC", seed=1):
    w, c, a, f = assets()
    return Game(w, c, a, f, city, seed)


def test_content_preserved():
    w, c, a, f = assets()
    assert c["version"] == 2 and len(c["cities"]) == 7
    for city in c["cities"]:
        assert len(city["scenarios"]) == 14 and len(city["branches"]) == 4 and len(city["callbacks"]) == 2
        for s in city["scenarios"] + city["branches"] + city["callbacks"]:
            core = [o for o in s["options"] if o["letter"] in "ABCD"]
            assert sorted(o["rating"] for o in core) == ["BEST", "OKAY", "RISKY", "WORST"], s["id"]
    assert len(MINIGAMES) == 8 and len(c["realistic_minigames"]) == 10 and len(c["events"]) == 5


def test_every_option_has_attributes():
    w, c, a, f = assets()
    for city in c["cities"]:
        for s in city["scenarios"] + city["branches"] + city["callbacks"]:
            for o in s["options"]:
                assert "attrs" in o and o["attrs"]["activity"] in PARAMS["activity_injury_mult"], (s["id"], o["letter"])


def test_rng_is_deterministic_and_matches_reference():
    r = Mulberry32(12345)
    vals = [r.random() for _ in range(3)]
    assert vals == [Mulberry32(12345).random() for _ in range(1)] + vals[1:]
    assert all(0 <= v < 1 for v in vals)
    assert Streams(7).get("injury").random() != Streams(7).get("infection").random()


def test_injury_formula_and_cap():
    g = new_game()
    o = {"injury_chance": 85, "damage": 30}
    a = {"setting": "open", "activity": "contact", "hours": 1, "exposure": "contact"}
    b = g.injury_breakdown(o, a, night=True)
    assert b["p"] == min(0.95, b["base"] * b["weather"] * b["activity"] * b["time"])
    assert b["p"] <= 0.95
    a2 = dict(a, setting="vehicle")
    assert g.injury_breakdown(o, a2, False)["weather"] == 1.0


def test_injury_does_not_depend_on_outbreak():
    g = new_game()
    o = {"injury_chance": 40, "damage": 20}
    a = {"setting": "open", "activity": "travel", "hours": 1, "exposure": "low"}
    p1 = g.injury_breakdown(o, a, False)["p"]
    g.hour = 150
    assert g.injury_breakdown(o, a, False)["p"] == p1


def test_infection_formula():
    g = new_game()
    g.hour = 100
    a = {"setting": "open", "activity": "scavenge", "hours": 2.0, "exposure": "medium"}
    b = g.infection_breakdown(a, night=False)
    expect = 1 - math.exp(-PARAMS["k_by_exposure"]["medium"] * g.local()[2] * 2.0 * 1.0)
    assert b["p"] == pytest.approx(expect)
    assert g.infection_breakdown(dict(a, exposure="none"), False)["p"] == 0
    assert g.infection_breakdown(dict(a, setting="vehicle"), False)["p"] < b["p"]


def test_resources_clamped_and_ledger_has_fuel():
    g = new_game()
    g.fuel = 10
    g.change("test", food=500, water=-500, fuel=500)
    assert g.food == 100 and g.water == 0 and g.fuel == PARAMS["tank_gallons"]
    assert any(l["fuel"] != 0 for l in g.ledger)


def test_cannot_drive_without_fuel():
    g = new_game()
    g.fuel = 0

    class UI(SimUI):
        seen = []

        def choose(self, game, scene, options, kind):
            self.seen.append(scene["id"])
            return "D"     # wait: never fixes the tank
    ui = UI(None)
    g.travel_to(ui, 1)
    assert g.ending == "STRANDED"
    assert ui.seen == ["FB-FUEL"] * PARAMS["max_fallbacks_per_leg"]
    assert g.miles == 0


def test_fuel_used_matches_mpg():
    g = new_game("SLC")
    g.travel_to(SimUI(POLICIES["balanced"]), 1)
    used = -sum(l["fuel"] for l in g.ledger if l["source"] == "fuel used driving")
    assert used == pytest.approx(g.miles / PARAMS["mpg"])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("city", CITIES)
def test_full_games_end_with_a_valid_ending(city):
    for pol in POLICIES.values():
        for seed in range(1, 6):
            g = play(city, seed, pol)
            assert g.ending in ENDINGS
            assert 0 <= g.health <= 100 and 0 <= g.food <= 100 and 0 <= g.water <= 100
            assert 0 <= g.fuel <= PARAMS["tank_gallons"]
            assert len(g.used_games) == len(set(g.used_games))      # no repeated mini game
            if g.ending == "VICTORY":
                assert g.health > 0 and g.hour <= PARAMS["deadline_hours"]
                assert g.miles == pytest.approx(g.total_mi)
                assert not g.infection or g.infection["treated"]


def test_victory_needs_arrival():
    g = new_game()
    g.miles = g.total_mi - 50
    g.arrive()
    assert g.ending == "STRANDED"


def test_late_arrival_is_not_victory():
    g = new_game()
    g.miles, g.hour = g.total_mi, PARAMS["deadline_hours"] + 1
    g.arrive()
    assert g.ending == "TOO_LATE"


def test_untreated_infection_turns():
    g = new_game()
    g.infection = {"at": 0.0, "warned": False, "treated": False}
    g.advance(PARAMS["incubation_hours_player"] + 0.1, "test")
    assert g.ending == "TURNED"


def test_medicine_treats_before_onset():
    for seed in range(1, 40):
        g = new_game(seed=seed)
        g.flags.append("MED_KIT")
        g.infection = {"at": 0.0, "warned": False, "treated": False}
        g.advance(PARAMS["incubation_hours_player"] + 1, "test")
        if g.infection["treated"]:
            assert g.ending is None and "MED_KIT" not in g.flags
            return
    pytest.fail("treatment never succeeded")


def test_time_costs_from_story_text_are_applied():
    g = new_game("NYC")
    s = next(x for x in g.city["scenarios"] if x["id"] == "NYC-05M")   # option A says it costs half a day
    a = next(o for o in s["options"] if o["letter"] == "A")["attrs"]
    assert a["hours"] >= 12
    h0 = g.hour
    g.resolve(s, next(o for o in s["options"] if o["letter"] == "A"), "main")
    assert g.hour - h0 == pytest.approx(a["hours"])


def test_same_seed_same_game():
    a, b = play("JAC", 99, POLICIES["random"]), play("JAC", 99, POLICIES["random"])
    assert a.history == b.history and a.hour == b.hour and a.health == b.health


def test_matched_streams_share_event_randomness():
    a, b = new_game("SEA", 5), new_game("SEA", 5)
    assert a.strength == b.strength
    assert a.rng.get("injury").random() == b.rng.get("injury").random()

FILE: tests/test_montecarlo.py

from zombie_sim.sim import monte_carlo
from zombie_sim.policies import POLICIES


def test_monte_carlo_is_reproducible_and_ranks_strategies():
    a = monte_carlo("PIT", POLICIES["balanced"], runs=60)
    b = monte_carlo("PIT", POLICIES["balanced"], runs=60)
    assert a["survival_rate"] == b["survival_rate"]
    r = monte_carlo("PIT", POLICIES["random"], runs=60)
    assert a["survival_rate"] > r["survival_rate"]
    assert abs(sum(a["endings"].values()) - 1) < 1e-9

================================================================================

"""The browser game (web/sim.js) must make exactly the same calculations as the Python engine."""
import json, os, shutil, subprocess
import pytest
from zombie_sim.sim import play
from zombie_sim.policies import POLICIES

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
CASES = [[c, s, p] for c in ["NYC", "BOS", "PIT", "SLC", "JAC", "SEA", "AUS"] for s in (1, 2, 3, 17, 404)
         for p in POLICIES]


@pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("node") is None, reason="Node.js not installed")
def test_python_and_javascript_agree():
    if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(HERE, "bundle.json")):
        pytest.fail("Run python tools/build_web.py first")
    out = subprocess.run(["node", os.path.join(HERE, "parity_runner.js"), json.dumps(CASES)],
                         capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    js = json.loads(out.stdout)
    assert len(js) == len(CASES)
    for (city, seed, pol), j in zip(CASES, js):
        g = play(city, seed, POLICIES[pol])
        tag = f"{city} seed {seed} {pol}"
        assert [list(h) for h in g.history] == j["history"], tag
        assert g.ending == j["ending"], tag
        assert g.used_games == j["minigames"], tag
        assert g.played_events == j["events"], tag
        for k in ("hours", "health", "food", "water", "fuel", "miles", "strength"):
            assert g.summary()[k] == pytest.approx(j[k], abs=1e-9), (tag, k)
        for a, b in zip([t.at(9.3) for t in g.traj], j["traj"]):
            assert a == pytest.approx(b, abs=1e-12), tag

================================================================================
FILE: tests/test_seir.py
================================================================================
import math
import pytest
from zombie_sim.seir import Trajectory, cold_multiplier, density_multiplier, sensitivity
from zombie_sim.params import PARAMS


@pytest.mark.parametrize("temp", [-60, -40, -13, 0, 10, 19.9, 20, 35, 50, 80])
def test_cold_multiplier_never_negative(temp):
    assert cold_multiplier(temp) >= PARAMS["stiff_floor"] * 0.999


def test_old_negative_beta_bug_is_fixed():
    # the old formula gave 1.63 x (1 - 0.03 x 40) = -0.33 at -20F
    assert cold_multiplier(-20) > 0


def test_density_multiplier_bounds():
    assert density_multiplier(0.5) == PARAMS["density_mult_min"]
    assert density_multiplier(1e9) == PARAMS["density_mult_max"]
    assert density_multiplier(100) == pytest.approx(1.0)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("density,temp", [(70503, 34), (1, 16), (2000, 50), (13190, -30)])
def test_compartments_nonnegative_and_conserved(density, temp):
    tr = Trajectory(density, temp, 1.1)
    for S, E, I, R in tr.points:
        assert min(S, E, I, R) >= 0
        assert S + E + I + R == pytest.approx(1.0, abs=1e-12)
        assert 0 <= I <= 1


def test_curve_is_calculated_and_grows_then_peaks():
    tr = Trajectory(1000, 30)
    infected = [p[1] + p[2] + p[3] for p in tr.points]
    assert all(b >= a - 1e-12 for a, b in zip(infected, infected[1:]))   # ever-infected never decreases
    I = [p[2] for p in tr.points]
    assert max(I) > 100 * PARAMS["initial_prevalence"]


def test_step_size_is_stable():
    p2 = dict(PARAMS, seir_dt_days=1 / 96)
    a, b = Trajectory(2000, 30), Trajectory(2000, 30, 1.0, p2)
    for t in (7, 9, 11, 13):
        assert a.at(t)[2] == pytest.approx(b.at(t)[2], abs=1e-4)


def test_r0_and_effective_r():
    tr = Trajectory(100, 50)   # density and cold multipliers both 1.0
    assert tr.r0(0) == pytest.approx(PARAMS["beta_base"] / PARAMS["gamma"])
    assert tr.r_effective(10) == pytest.approx(tr.r0(10) * tr.at(10)[0])
    assert tr.r_effective(10) < tr.r0(10)


def test_independent_trajectories():
    a = Trajectory(500, 30).at(10)
    Trajectory(70000, 30)
    assert Trajectory(500, 30).at(10) == a


def test_sensitivity_moves_in_expected_direction():
    rows = sensitivity([(1000, 30)], [1.0, 2.0], [0.15, 0.3], 10.5)
    get = lambda b, g: next(r for r in rows if r["beta"] == b and r["gamma"] == g)["max_prev"]
    assert get(2.0, 0.15) > get(1.0, 0.15)
    assert get(1.0, 0.3) < get(1.0, 0.15)

import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.request, urllib.error
import pytest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def server():
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, os.path.join(ROOT, "server.py"), "--port", "8799"],
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    for _ in range(50):
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8799/health", timeout=1)
            break
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.1)
    yield "http://127.0.0.1:8799"
    p.terminate()
    p.wait()


def test_serves_game_and_health(server):
    assert urllib.request.urlopen(server + "/health").read() == b"ok"
    html = urllib.request.urlopen(server + "/").read().decode()
    assert "Zombie" in html and "sim.js" in html
    assert urllib.request.urlopen(server + "/data.js").status == 200


def test_monte_carlo_api(server):
    r = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(server + "/api/montecarlo?city=SLC&policy=random&runs=20").read())
    assert r["runs"] == 20 and 0 <= r["survival_rate"] <= 1


def test_bad_request(server):
    with pytest.raises(urllib.error.HTTPError) as e:
        urllib.request.urlopen(server + "/api/montecarlo?city=ZZZ")
    assert e.value.code == 400

"""Rules added with the revised scenarios (v2)."""
import pytest
from zombie_sim.sim import assets, SimUI, play
from zombie_sim.engine import Game
from zombie_sim.policies import POLICIES
from zombie_sim.params import PARAMS
from zombie_sim.seir import age_multiplier


def new_game(city="NYC", seed=1):
    w, c, a, f = assets()
    return Game(w, c, a, f, city, seed)


def scene(g, sid):
    return next(s for s in g.city["scenarios"] + g.city["branches"] + g.city["callbacks"] if s["id"] == sid)


class Rec(SimUI):
    def __init__(self, policy=POLICIES["balanced"]):
        super().__init__(policy)
        self.scenes, self.msgs = [], []

    def choose(self, game, s, options, kind):
        self.scenes.append(s["id"])
        return self.policy(game, s, options)

    def message(self, game, title, msgs):
        self.msgs.append((title, list(msgs)))


def test_svi_loaded_and_valid():
    w = assets()[0]
    assert len(w["svi"]) == 44
    assert w["svi"]["48375"]["svi"] == pytest.approx(0.9889)       # Potter County, TX
    assert 15 < w["age_ref"] < 17


def test_age_multiplier_bounds_and_direction():
    assert age_multiplier(None, 16) == 1.0
    assert age_multiplier(26, 16) == pytest.approx(1.1)
    assert age_multiplier(0, 16) == pytest.approx(0.9)
    assert age_multiplier(18, 16) > 1 > age_multiplier(14, 16)


def test_unlocked_option_needs_its_flag():
    g = new_game("NYC")
    s = scene(g, "NYC-07N")
    assert "E" not in [o["letter"] for o in g.visible_options(s)]
    g.flags.append("NJ_CONTACTS")
    assert "E" in [o["letter"] for o in g.visible_options(s)]


def test_conditional_options_follow_state():
    g = new_game("NYC")
    g.scene_index = 10
    s = scene(g, "NYC-06M")
    letters = lambda: [o["letter"] for o in g.visible_options(s)]
    assert "F" not in letters()
    g.fuel = 3
    assert "F" in letters()
    n = scene(g, "NYC-01N")
    g.scene_index = 1
    assert "R" not in [o["letter"] for o in g.visible_options(n)]
    g.health = 30
    assert "R" in [o["letter"] for o in g.visible_options(n)]


def test_treatment_option_cures_most_infections():
    cured = 0
    for seed in range(1, 101):
        g = new_game("NYC", seed)
        g.infection = {"at": 0.0, "warned": True, "treated": False}
        s = scene(g, "NYC-05M")
        o = next(x for x in s["options"] if x.get("condition") == "infected_symptoms")
        g.resolve(s, o, "main")
        cured += g.infection["treated"]
    assert 80 <= cured <= 98      # 90% treatment success


def test_every_health_loss_has_a_reason():
    for city in ("NYC", "BOS", "JAC"):
        for seed in range(1, 15):
            ui = Rec(POLICIES["random"])
            g = Game(*assets()[:2], assets()[2], assets()[3], city, seed)
            g.run(ui)
            for title, msgs in ui.msgs:
                for m in msgs:
                    if "health" in m["text"] and m["text"].startswith("-"):
                        assert ": " in m["text"] and len(m["text"].split(": ", 1)[1]) > 3, m


def test_gate_quarantine_does_not_count_against_deadline():
    g = new_game("SLC")
    s = scene(g, "SLC-07N")
    g.scene_index, g.place = 13, g.places[13]
    g.miles, g.hour = g.total_mi, 150.0
    a = next(o for o in s["options"] if o["letter"] == "A")
    g.resolve(s, a, "main")
    g.arrive()
    assert g.ending == "VICTORY" and g.quarantine_hours == 24 and g.hour < PARAMS["deadline_hours"]


def test_gate_fuel_offer_depends_on_fuel():
    for fuel, ok in ((10, True), (2, False)):
        g = new_game("JAC")
        s = scene(g, "JAC-07N")
        g.scene_index, g.place, g.fuel, g.hour = 13, g.places[13], fuel, 150.0
        c = next(o for o in s["options"] if o["letter"] == "C")
        h0 = g.hour
        g.resolve(s, c, "main")
        assert (g.fuel == pytest.approx(fuel - 5)) if ok else (g.hour - h0 >= 10)


def test_events_play_where_the_data_says():
    # Boston (Suffolk County) has CDC SVI 0.78 >= 0.75: the gridlock scene plays on Day 1
    ui = Rec()
    g = Game(*assets()[:2], assets()[2], assets()[3], "BOS", 2)
    g.run(ui)
    assert "EV-SVI" in g.played_events and ui.scenes.index("EV-SVI") < ui.scenes.index("BOS-01M")
    # every route hears the radio doctor on Day 3 Night (if still alive then)
    for city in ("NYC", "SEA", "AUS"):
        g = play(city, 4, POLICIES["balanced"])
        if g.hour > 60:
            assert "EV-R0" in g.played_events


def test_realistic_minigame_plays_after_its_story_option():
    g = new_game("PIT")
    s = scene(g, "PIT-05M")
    ui = Rec()
    o = next(x for x in s["options"] if x["letter"] == "A")
    assert o["minigame"] == "Put On Tire Chains"
    g.place = g.places[8]
    g.scene_index = 8
    g.realistic_game(ui, o["minigame"], "NORMAL", story=True)
    assert "Put On Tire Chains" in g.used_games
    n = len(ui.msgs)
    g.realistic_game(ui, o["minigame"], "NORMAL", story=True)   # no repeats
    assert len(ui.msgs) == n


def test_no_minigame_repeats_with_18_games():
    for city in ("NYC", "PIT", "SEA"):
        for seed in range(1, 30):
            g = play(city, seed, POLICIES["random"])
            assert len(g.used_games) == len(set(g.used_games))


def test_arrival_seeding_hits_targets():
    """v3: every route stop's starting level puts it near its arrival target (strength 1.0)."""
    from zombie_sim.data_loader import load_world
    from zombie_sim.seir import Trajectory, arrival_day, seed_target, age_multiplier
    w = load_world()
    for stops in w["routes"].values():
        for k, s in enumerate(stops):
            c, st, sv = w["counties"][s["geoid"]], w["stations"][s["station"]], w["svi"].get(s["geoid"])
            am = age_multiplier(sv["pct65"], w["age_ref"]) if sv else 1.0
            I = Trajectory(c["density"], st["tavg_f"], 1.0, age_mult=am, i0=s["i0"]).at(arrival_day(k))[2]
            assert abs(I - seed_target(k, c["density"])) < 0.01, (s["label"], I)


def test_seed_target_shape():
    from zombie_sim.seir import seed_target
    assert seed_target(0, 100) < seed_target(3, 100) < seed_target(7, 100)   # rises over the trip
    assert seed_target(3, 10) < seed_target(3, 100) < seed_target(3, 10000)  # density tilt
    assert seed_target(0, 1) >= 0.02                                          # floor

================================================================================
FILE: tools/build_content_v2.py

"""
Build content/scenarios_v2.json: the playable version of the revised scenario document
(docs/word/Zombie_Escape_Revised_Scenarios.docx).

Inputs
  content/scenarios.json, content/option_attributes.csv   original story + attributes from the text
  scenario_revisions/revised.json                           rule-based rebalancing, traps/gems, flags, gates
  scenario_revisions/handwritten.py                         unlocked options, conditional options, gates, event scenes
  scenario_revisions/minigames_new.py                       realistic mini games + where they play

Every option in the output carries its own 'attrs' (time, exposure, setting, fuel...), so the engine
does not need option_attributes.csv for v2 content.
"""
import csv
import json
import os
import re
import sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "scenario_revisions"))
import handwritten as HW          # noqa: E402
import minigames_new as MGN       # noqa: E402

ORIG = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "content", "scenarios.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
REV = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "scenario_revisions", "revised.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
ATTR = {r["option_key"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "content", "option_attributes.csv"), encoding="utf-8"))}


def base_attrs(key):
    r = ATTR[key]
    return {"activity": r["activity"], "hours": float(r["hours"]), "exposure": r["exposure"], "setting": r["setting"],
            "fuel_gal": float(r["fuel_gal"]), "vehicle": r["vehicle"], "miles_bonus": float(r["miles_bonus"]),
            "travel_hours_saved": float(r["travel_hours_saved"]), "denied_entry": r["denied_entry"] in ("1", "True"),
            "medicine": r["medicine"] in ("1", "True"), "evidence": r["evidence"]}


def mk_attrs(activity="social", hours=1.0, exposure="low", setting="open", fuel=0.0, vehicle="", miles=0.0,
             saved=0.0, medicine=False, evidence="hand-written v2 option"):
    return {"activity": activity, "hours": float(hours), "exposure": exposure, "setting": setting, "fuel_gal": float(fuel),
            "vehicle": vehicle, "miles_bonus": float(miles), "travel_hours_saved": float(saved), "denied_entry": False,
            "medicine": medicine, "evidence": evidence}


def parse_fx(text):
    """Turn the short effect text written in handwritten.py into numbers."""
    t = text.lower()
    fx = {"hours": 1.0, "fuel": 0.0, "food": 0, "water": 0, "heal": 0, "saved": 0.0, "injury": 0, "treat": False,
          "exposure": "low"}
    m = re.match(r"\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) h\b", t)
    if m:
        fx["hours"] = float(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r"\+(\d+) gal", t)
    if m:
        fx["fuel"] = float(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r"-(\d+) food", t)
    if m:
        fx["food"] = -int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r"\+(\d+) health", t)
    if m:
        fx["heal"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r"saves (\d+) h", t)
    if m:
        fx["saved"] = float(m.group(1))
        fx["hours"] = 0.5
    m = re.search(r"injury risk (\d+)%", t)
    if m:
        fx["injury"] = int(m.group(1))
    if "treatment 90%" in t:
        fx["treat"] = True
    if "high exposure" in t or "high-exposure" in t:
        fx["exposure"] = "high"
    elif "medium exposure" in t:
        fx["exposure"] = "medium"
    return fx


RATING_INJ = {"BEST": (5, 6), "OKAY": (12, 10), "RISKY": (40, 15), "WORST": (65, 22)}


def option_from_fx(letter, text, rating, eff, why, extra=None, activity="social", setting="open"):
    fx = parse_fx(eff)
    inj, dmg = RATING_INJ[rating]
    if fx["injury"]:
        inj = fx["injury"]
    o = {"letter": letter, "text": text, "note": why, "rating": rating, "looks": "", "effects_text": eff,
         "injury_chance": inj, "damage": dmg, "food": fx["food"], "water": fx["water"], "heal": fx["heal"],
         "attrs": mk_attrs(activity=activity, hours=fx["hours"], exposure=fx["exposure"], setting=setting,
                           fuel=fx["fuel"], saved=fx["saved"], evidence="hand-written v2: " + eff)}
    if fx["treat"]:
        o["treat"] = True
    if extra:
        o.update(extra)
    return o


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- final gates, as numbers
def gate(letter, text, rating, looks, why, hours=1.0, harm=0, harm_reason="", food=0, water=0, inj=0, dmg=0,
         quarantine=0.0, lose_vehicle=False, needs_fuel=0.0, fuel_cost=0.0, else_hours=0.0, eff=""):
    o = {"letter": letter, "text": text, "note": why, "rating": rating, "looks": looks, "effects_text": eff,
         "injury_chance": inj, "damage": dmg, "food": food, "water": water, "heal": 0,
         "attrs": mk_attrs(activity="social", hours=hours, exposure="low", setting="open", evidence="final gate: " + eff),
         "gate": {"quarantine_h": quarantine}}
    if harm:
        o["harm"] = {"health": harm, "reason": harm_reason}
    if lose_vehicle:
        o["attrs"]["vehicle"] = "lost"
    if needs_fuel:
        o["gate"].update({"needs_fuel": needs_fuel, "fuel_cost": fuel_cost, "else_hours": else_hours})
    return o

                 gate("C", *G["SEA-07N"][2][1:4], G["SEA-07N"][2][5], hours=1, eff=G["SEA-07N"][2][4]),
                 gate("D", *G["SEA-07N"][3][1:4], G["SEA-07N"][3][5], hours=4, harm=20, harm_reason="chased to another entrance", eff=G["SEA-07N"][3][4])],
     "AUS-07N": [gate("A", *G["AUS-07N"][0][1:4], G["AUS-07N"][0][5], hours=1, food=-20, eff=G["AUS-07N"][0][4]),
                 gate("B", *G["AUS-07N"][1][1:4], G["AUS-07N"][1][5], hours=10, eff=G["AUS-07N"][1][4]),
                 gate("C", *G["AUS-07N"][2][1:4], G["AUS-07N"][2][5], hours=3, eff=G["AUS-07N"][2][4]),
                 gate("D", *G["AUS-07N"][3][1:4], G["AUS-07N"][3][5], hours=1, eff=G["AUS-07N"][3][4])],
    }
    return out

def unlocked_option(u):
    f = UNLOCK_FX[u["flag"]]
    o = {"letter": "E", "text": u["text"], "note": u["why"], "rating": u["rating"], "looks": "", "effects_text": u["effects_text"],
         "injury_chance": 3, "damage": 5, "food": 0, "water": 0, "heal": 0, "unlock_flag": u["flag"],
         "attrs": mk_attrs(activity="social", hours=f.get("hours", 1.0), exposure="low",
                           setting="vehicle" if f.get("fuel") or f.get("saved") else "open",
                           fuel=f.get("fuel", 0.0), saved=f.get("saved", 0.0), evidence=f"unlocked by {u['flag']}")}
    if "gate" in f:
        o["gate"] = f["gate"]
    return o


COND_KEY = {"Low fuel (under 5 gal)": "low_fuel", "Infected (symptoms showing)": "infected_symptoms",
            "Behind schedule (over 12 h)": "behind"}


def conditional_option(c, i):
    kind = COND_KEY[c["when"]]
    act = {"low_fuel": "scavenge", "infected_symptoms": "social", "behind": "travel"}[kind]
    setting = {"low_fuel": "open", "infected_symptoms": "shelter", "behind": "vehicle"}[kind]
    o = option_from_fx("F" if i == 0 else "G", c["text"], c["rating"], c["effects_text"], c["why"],
                       extra={"condition": kind}, activity=act, setting=setting)
    if kind == "infected_symptoms":
        o["treat"] = True
        o["injury_chance"] = 2
    return o


def rest_option():
    return {"letter": "R", "text": "Rest the whole night before moving on", "note": "Sleep heals, but costs time you may not have.",
            "rating": "OKAY", "looks": "", "effects_text": "10 h; +15 health", "injury_chance": 5, "damage": 5,
            "food": 0, "water": 0, "heal": 15, "condition": "low_health",
            "attrs": mk_attrs(activity="shelter", hours=10, exposure="low", setting="shelter", evidence="general rule: low health")}

def realistic_games():
    out = []
    for g in MGN.GAMES:
        name = g[0]
        out.append({"name": name, "how": g[1], "steps": g[2], "mistakes": g[3], "data": g[4], "tiers": g[5],
                    "win_text": g[6], "fail_text": g[7], "fx": RMG_FX[name]})
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assemble
def main():
    gate_opts = gates()
    place = {}
    for code, pl in MGN.PLACEMENT.items():
        for sid, L, g, why in pl:
            place[(sid, L)] = (g, why)
    cities = []
    for oc, rc in zip(ORIG["cities"], REV["cities"]):
        assert oc["code"] == rc["code"]
        orig_scenes = {s["id"]: s for s in oc["scenarios"] + oc["branches"] + oc["callbacks"]}
        new = {"code": oc["code"], "start": oc["start"], "end": oc["end"], "route": oc["route"], "profile": rc["profile"],
               "scenarios": [], "branches": [], "callbacks": []}
        for s in rc["scenes"]:
            so = orig_scenes[s["id"]]
            s2 = {k: so[k] for k in so if k != "options"}
            s2["weather_note"] = s.get("weather_note", "")
            if s["id"] in gate_opts:
                opts = gate_opts[s["id"]]
            else:
                opts = []
                for ro, oo in zip(s["options"], so["options"]):
                    assert ro["letter"] == oo["letter"]
                    a = base_attrs(f"{s['id']}:{oo['letter']}")
                    a["hours"] = ro["hours"]
                    if ro.get("hours_saved"):
                        a["travel_hours_saved"] = max(a["travel_hours_saved"], ro["hours_saved"])
                    o = dict(oo)
                    o.update({"rating": ro["rating"], "looks": ro.get("looks", ""), "injury_chance": ro["injury_chance"],
                              "food": ro["food"], "water": ro["water"], "heal": ro["heal"], "attrs": a,
                              "changes": ro.get("changes", [])})
                    if ro.get("weather_rating"):
                        o["weather_rating"] = ro["weather_rating"]
                    flags = [f.strip() for f in (ro.get("sets_flag") or "").split(",") if f.strip()]
                    o.pop("sets_flag", None)
                    if flags:
                        o["sets_flags"] = flags
                    if o.get("alt"):
                        akey = f"{s['id']}:{oo['letter']}:alt"
                        o["alt"] = dict(o["alt"], attrs=base_attrs(akey))
                    mg = place.get((s["id"], oo["letter"]))
                    if mg:
                        o["minigame"] = mg[0]
                        o["minigame_why"] = mg[1]
                    opts.append(o)
            for u in s.get("unlocked", []):
                o = unlocked_option(u)
                mg = place.get((s["id"], "★"))
                if mg:
                    o["minigame"], o["minigame_why"] = mg
                opts.append(o)
            for i, c in enumerate(s.get("conditional", [])):
                opts.append(conditional_option(c, i))
            if s["kind"] == "main" and s.get("time") == "Night" and not s["id"].endswith("07N"):
                opts.append(rest_option())
            s2["options"] = opts
            {"main": new["scenarios"], "detour": new["branches"], "callback": new["callbacks"]}[s["kind"]].append(s2)
        cities.append(new)
    out = {"version": 2, "source": "docs/word/Zombie_Escape_Revised_Scenarios.docx", "cities": cities,
           "events": events(), "realistic_minigames": realistic_games(), "minigame_rules": MGN.SHARED_RULES}
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "content", "scenarios_v2.json")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    n = sum(len(c[k]) for c in cities for k in ("scenarios", "branches", "callbacks"))
    nopt = sum(len(s["options"]) for c in cities for k in ("scenarios", "branches", "callbacks") for s in c[k])
    print(f"Wrote {path}: {n} scenes, {nopt} options, {len(out['events'])} event scenes, {len(out['realistic_minigames'])} realistic mini games")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Inline data.js, sim.js, realgames.js and game.js into one HTML file: web/zombie_escape_full_game.html."""
import os, re
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WEB = os.path.join(ROOT, "web")
html = open(os.path.join(WEB, "index.html"), encoding="utf-8").read()
def inline(m):
    js = open(os.path.join(WEB, m.group(1)), encoding="utf-8").read().replace("</script", "<\\/script")
    return f"<script>\n/* ---- {m.group(1)} ---- */\n{js}\n</script>"
out = re.sub(r'<script src="([a-z]+\.js)"></script>', inline, html)
path = os.path.join(WEB, "zombie_escape_full_game.html")
open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(out)
print(f"Wrote {path} ({os.path.getsize(path) / 1024:.0f} KB)")

"""Bundle data/, content/ and params into web/data.js for the browser game.
Re-run after changing any CSV, the scenario content, or zombie_sim/params.py."""
import json, os, sys
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
from zombie_sim.data_loader import load_world
from zombie_sim.attributes import load_attributes, load_content, CONTENT
from zombie_sim.engine import load_fallbacks
from zombie_sim.params import PARAMS, MINIGAMES, MINIGAME_ORDER, CURE_FLAGS


def read_csv(name):
    import csv
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def bundle():
    w = load_world()
    return {"params": PARAMS, "minigames": MINIGAMES, "minigame_order": MINIGAME_ORDER, "cure_flags": CURE_FLAGS,
            "world": w, "content": load_content(os.path.join(CONTENT, "scenarios_v2.json")), "attrs": load_attributes(), "fallbacks": load_fallbacks(),
            "reference": {"r0": read_csv("r0_reference.csv"), "rabies": read_csv("rabies_reference.csv")}}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    b = bundle()
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "web", "data.js")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("// Generated by tools/build_web.py from data/*.csv, content/ and zombie_sim/params.py. Do not edit by hand.\n")
        f.write("window.GAME_DATA = " + json.dumps(b, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + ";\n")
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "tests", "bundle.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(b, f, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"Wrote {path} ({os.path.getsize(path) / 1024:.0f} KB)")

================================================================================
FILE: tools/download_new_data.py
================================================================================
"""
Download the next round of real data for Zombie Escape (does NOT change or run the game).

  python tools/download_new_data.py            # everything
  python tools/download_new_data.py --only svi
  python tools/download_new_data.py --only age     (needs a free Census API key, see below)
  python tools/download_new_data.py --only reference

Creates these files in data/ (next to city_data.csv):

  svi_data.csv          CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, one row per game county
  age_data.csv          Census ACS 5-year 2019-2023: population 65+, median age, per game county
  rabies_reference.csv  Rabies incubation and post-exposure treatment timing (CDC publications)
  r0_reference.csv      Published R0 values for real diseases (peer-reviewed studies)

Rules this script follows:
  * It only downloads; it never edits the game's parameters or code.
  * A value the source does not publish (CDC uses -999) is written as BLANK, never 0.
  * Every failed download stops with a clear message. Nothing is silently skipped or invented.
  * The two reference files are not downloadable datasets. They are values copied by hand from
    the publications listed in their 'source' and 'url' columns, so they can be checked.

Census API key (needed only for age_data.csv):
  1. Get a free key: https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html
  2. Windows:   set CENSUS_API_KEY=yourkey        Mac/Linux:  export CENSUS_API_KEY=yourkey
  3. Run this script again.

Standard library only (Python 3.10+).
"""
import argparse
import csv
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from datetime import date

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "data")
TODAY = date.today().isoformat()
UA = {"User-Agent": "ZombieEscape-class-project/1.0"}

SVI_URL = ("https://onemap.cdc.gov/onemapservices/rest/services/SVI/"
           "CDC_ATSDR_Social_Vulnerability_Index_2022_USA/MapServer/1/query")
ACS_YEAR = "2023"   # ACS 5-year 2019-2023
ACS_URL = f"https://api.census.gov/data/{ACS_YEAR}/acs/acs5"
# B01001 = Sex by Age. 65+ = male 020-025 + female 044-049. B01002_001E = median age.
AGE65_VARS = [f"B01001_{n:03d}E" for n in list(range(20, 26)) + list(range(44, 50))]


class DownloadError(Exception):
    pass


def get_json(url, tries=3):
    last = None
    for k in range(tries):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
                text = r.read().decode("utf-8")
            try:
                return json.loads(text)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                raise DownloadError(f"Not JSON from {url[:120]}...\nFirst 300 characters:\n{text[:300]}")
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as e:
            last = e
            time.sleep(2 * (k + 1))
    raise DownloadError(f"Could not reach {url[:120]}... after {tries} tries: {last}")


def game_counties():
    path = os.path.join(DATA, "city_data.csv")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise DownloadError(f"{path} not found. Run this script from inside the zombie_escape folder.")
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    return [(r["geoid"], r["county_name"], r["state_name"]) for r in rows]


def num_or_blank(v):
    """CDC SVI uses -999 for 'not available'. Keep it blank, never 0."""
    if v is None:
        return ""
    try:
        x = float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    return "" if x <= -999 else x


def write_csv(name, fields, rows, note):
    path = os.path.join(DATA, name)
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    print(f"  wrote {path} ({len(rows)} rows) - {note}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022
def download_svi():
    print("CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022 (county layer)...")
    counties = game_counties()
    fields = ["STCNTY", "COUNTY", "STATE", "E_TOTPOP", "RPL_THEMES", "RPL_THEME1", "RPL_THEME2",
              "RPL_THEME3", "RPL_THEME4", "EP_NOVEH", "EP_AGE65", "EP_CROWD", "EP_MUNIT", "EP_DISABL"]
    found = {}
    for i in range(0, len(counties), 10):
        batch = counties[i:i + 10]
        where = "STCNTY IN (" + ",".join(f"'{g}'" for g, _, _ in batch) + ")"
        url = SVI_URL + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"where": where, "outFields": ",".join(fields),
                                                       "returnGeometry": "false", "f": "json"})
        data = get_json(url)
        if "error" in data:
            raise DownloadError(f"CDC SVI service error: {data['error']}")
        for feat in data.get("features", []):
            a = feat["attributes"]
            found[str(a["STCNTY"]).zfill(5)] = a
        time.sleep(0.5)
    missing = [g for g, _, _ in counties if g not in found]
    if missing:
        raise DownloadError(f"SVI has no row for these game counties: {missing}")
    rows = []
    for g, name, state in counties:
        a = found[g]
        rows.append({
            "geoid": g, "county_name": a["COUNTY"], "state_name": a["STATE"],
            "svi_year": 2022, "svi_population": num_or_blank(a["E_TOTPOP"]),
            "svi_overall": num_or_blank(a["RPL_THEMES"]),
            "svi_socioeconomic": num_or_blank(a["RPL_THEME1"]),
            "svi_household": num_or_blank(a["RPL_THEME2"]),
            "svi_minority_language": num_or_blank(a["RPL_THEME3"]),
            "svi_housing_transport": num_or_blank(a["RPL_THEME4"]),
            "pct_no_vehicle": num_or_blank(a["EP_NOVEH"]),
            "pct_age65_svi": num_or_blank(a["EP_AGE65"]),
            "pct_crowded_housing": num_or_blank(a["EP_CROWD"]),
            "pct_multiunit_housing": num_or_blank(a["EP_MUNIT"]),
            "pct_disability": num_or_blank(a["EP_DISABL"]),
            "source": "CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022, county layer (built from ACS 2018-2022)",
            "retrieved": TODAY,
        })
    write_csv("svi_data.csv", list(rows[0]), rows,
              "percentile ranks 0-1 (1 = most vulnerable); blank = not published by CDC")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. Census ACS age structure
def download_age():
    print(f"Census ACS 5-year {int(ACS_YEAR) - 4}-{ACS_YEAR}: age structure (table B01001, B01002)...")
    key = os.environ.get("CENSUS_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if not key:
        raise DownloadError("CENSUS_API_KEY is not set. The Census API now requires a free key:\n"
                            "  1. https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html\n"
                            "  2. set CENSUS_API_KEY=yourkey  (Mac/Linux: export CENSUS_API_KEY=yourkey)\n"
                            "  3. run: python tools/download_new_data.py --only age")
    counties = game_counties()
    by_state = {}
    for g, _, _ in counties:
        by_state.setdefault(g[:2], []).append(g[2:])
    get = ["NAME", "B01001_001E", "B01002_001E"] + AGE65_VARS
    values = {}
    for st, cos in sorted(by_state.items()):
        url = ACS_URL + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"get": ",".join(get), "for": "county:" + ",".join(cos),
                                                      "in": f"state:{st}", "key": key})
        data = get_json(url)
        head = data[0]
        for row in data[1:]:
            r = dict(zip(head, row))
            values[r["state"] + r["county"]] = r
        time.sleep(0.3)
    missing = [g for g, _, _ in counties if g not in values]
    if missing:
        raise DownloadError(f"ACS returned no row for: {missing}")
    rows = []
    for g, name, state in counties:
        r = values[g]
        total = float(r["B01001_001E"])
        parts = [r[v] for v in AGE65_VARS]
        if total <= 0 or any(p is None or float(p) < 0 for p in parts):
            raise DownloadError(f"ACS value missing or negative for county {g}: {r}")
        age65 = sum(float(p) for p in parts)
        med = float(r["B01002_001E"])
        rows.append({
            "geoid": g, "county_name": name, "state_name": state, "acs_name": r["NAME"],
            "acs_total_population": int(total), "acs_age65plus": int(age65),
            "pct_age65plus": round(100 * age65 / total, 2),
            "median_age": "" if med < 0 else med,
            "source": f"Census ACS 5-year {int(ACS_YEAR) - 4}-{ACS_YEAR}, B01001 + B01002",
            "retrieved": TODAY,
        })
    write_csv("age_data.csv", list(rows[0]), rows, "65+ share calculated from B01001 age groups")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. reference tables (from publications)

def write_reference():
    print("Reference tables from published sources (entered by hand, with citations)...")
    rows = [dict(zip(["parameter", "value", "doses", "source", "url", "note"], r)) for r in RABIES]
    for r in rows:
        r["entered"] = TODAY
    write_csv("rabies_reference.csv", list(rows[0]), rows, "CDC rabies timing; check each url before citing")
    rows = [dict(zip(["disease", "r0_low", "r0_high", "r0_central", "measure", "source", "url"], r)) for r in R0]
    for r in rows:
        r["entered"] = TODAY
    write_csv("r0_reference.csv", list(rows[0]), rows, "real-disease R0 for comparison only; blank = not reported")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--only", choices=["svi", "age", "reference"])
    a = ap.parse_args()
    jobs = {"svi": download_svi, "age": download_age, "reference": write_reference}
    failed = []
    for name, fn in jobs.items():
        if a.only and a.only != name:
            continue
        try:
            fn()
        except DownloadError as e:
            failed.append(name)
            print(f"  FAILED ({name}): {e}\n")
    if failed:
        print("Finished with failures:", ", ".join(failed))
        return 1
    print("All downloads finished. The game itself was not changed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

================================================================================
FILE: tools/monte_carlo_report.py
