  };
  const COL = { bg: "#070c12", line: "#2b3d4f", frost: "#e6eef3", muted: "#93a7b7", hazard: "#ff8a1f", ice: "#8ccbe8", blood: "#ef5b5f", safe: "#5cc785", food: "#e3b45a" };

  function stakes(name, tier, double) {
    const R = B.content.realistic_minigames.find((x) => x.name === name);
    if (R) return `<b>Win:</b> ${esc(R.win_text)}. <b>Lose:</b> ${tier === "EASY" ? "nothing (EASY tier)" : esc(R.fail_text)}.`;
    const rw = B.minigames[name];
    if (tier === "HARD") return `<b>Win:</b> +${P.hard_win_health} health. <b>Lose:</b> −${P.hard_loss_damage[0]} to −${P.hard_loss_damage[1]} health.`;
    if (tier === "NORMAL") return `<b>Win:</b> +${P.minigame_reward.NORMAL} ${rw}. <b>Lose:</b> −${P.normal_loss_damage[0]} to −${P.normal_loss_damage[1]} health.`;
    return `<b>Win:</b> +${P.minigame_reward.EASY * (double ? 2 : 1)} ${rw}${double ? " (double reward)" : ""}. <b>Lose:</b> nothing.`;
  }
  // real-world context for the realistic games, taken from the current stop
  function realEnv(g, name) {
    const a = g.place.a, b = Math.min(7, g.place.a === g.place.b ? a + 1 : g.place.b), s1 = g.stops[a], s2 = g.stops[b];
    const temp = g.weather()[0], I = g.local()[2];
    const rad = Math.PI / 180, dl = (s2.lon - s1.lon) * rad;
    const bearing = a === b ? 0 : (Math.atan2(Math.sin(dl) * Math.cos(s2.lat * rad), Math.cos(s1.lat * rad) * Math.sin(s2.lat * rad) - Math.sin(s1.lat * rad) * Math.cos(s2.lat * rad) * Math.cos(dl)) / rad + 360) % 360;
    const cname = (s) => g.counties[s.geoid].name + ", " + g.counties[s.geoid].state;
    const others = shuffle(g.stops.filter((s, i) => i !== a).map(cname));
    const otherSafe = shuffle(B.content.cities.map((c) => c.end).filter((e) => e !== g.city.end)).slice(0, 2);
    return { G: B.content.realistic_minigames.find((x) => x.name === name), dev, tempF: temp, tempFtxt: uT(temp, 0), tempWrong1: uT(temp + 18, 0), tempWrong2: uT(temp - 18, 0),
      I, elevM: g.stations[s1.station].elev_m || 0, bearing, here: cname(s1), others, nextLabel: s2.label, nextCounty: cname(s2),
      safeName: g.city.end, otherSafe, infected: !!(g.infection && !g.infection.treated), coldLag: Math.max(0, Math.min(0.5, (32 - temp) / 50)) };
  }
  const REAL = window.ZE_REAL({ el, esc, makeCanvas: (a, w, h) => makeCanvas(a, w, h), text: (...a) => text(...a), COL,
    setKey: (f) => (keyHandler = f), setKeyUp: (f) => (keyUpHandler = f) });

  function playMinigame(name, tier, double, g) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const isReal = !!B.content.realistic_minigames.find((x) => x.name === name);
      const env = isReal && g ? realEnv(g, name) : null;
      const card = el("div", "card");
      const head = el("div", "mg-head", `<h2 style="font-size:clamp(28px,6vw,40px)">${esc(name)}</h2><span class="pill ${tier}">${tier}${double ? " · DOUBLE REWARD" : ""}</span>`);
      card.appendChild(el("div", "tag", isReal ? "Mini game · real-world skill" : "Mini game"));
      card.appendChild(head);
      let rows;
      if (isReal) {
        const steps = REAL.steps(name, tier, env), kinds = new Set(steps.map((s) => s.kind));
        const ctl = ["<b>1–5</b> or click a card: pick the right next step"];
        if (kinds.has("tap")) ctl.push("<b>SPACE</b> (or the button) repeatedly: tap / dig / turn");
        if (kinds.has("hold") || kinds.has("crank")) ctl.push("<b>hold SPACE</b> (or press and hold the button): raise the gauge, let go to lower it");
        if (kinds.has("stop")) ctl.push("<b>SPACE</b> or STOP: stop the climbing bar inside the green window");
        if (kinds.has("tune")) ctl.push("<b>LEFT/RIGHT</b> arrows, ◀ ▶ or the slider: tune until it's clear, then hold still");
        if (kinds.has("rhythm")) ctl.push("<b>SPACE</b> when the white ring is inside the green ring");
        if (kinds.has("inspect")) ctl.push("click each <b>Check</b> card to look closer");
        const lim = dev ? "no time limit (developer mode)" : `${(env.G.tiers.match(new RegExp(tier + "\\s+(\\d+)\\s*s")) || [0, { EASY: 120, NORMAL: 90, HARD: 70 }[tier]])[1]} seconds`;
        rows = [["Goal", `Do it the real way, in order: ${steps.map((s) => esc(s.short)).join(" → ")}.` + (tier === "EASY" ? "" : " (The order is hidden on NORMAL and HARD: work it out.)")],
          ["Controls", ctl.join("<br>")],
          ["To win", `Finish every step within ${lim}, before the NOISE meter reaches 100. Wrong steps cost time and add noise (more noise where more infected are around).`],
          ["Watch out", esc(env.G.mistakes)],
          ["Real data", `January normal here: ${uT(env.tempF)}${env.coldLag > 0 ? ` (below freezing: cold hands slow your controls by ${Math.round(env.coldLag * 100)}%)` : " (no cold-hands slowdown)"}.`],
          ["Stakes", stakes(name, tier, double)]];
      } else {
        const I = INFO[name];
        card.appendChild(el("p", "text", esc(I.story)));
        rows = [["Goal", esc(I.goal)], ["Controls", esc(I.controls)], ["To win", esc(I.win)], ["Stakes", stakes(name, tier, double)]];
      }
      card.appendChild(el("table", "howto", rows.map(([k, v]) => `<tr><th>${k}</th><td>${v}</td></tr>`).join("")));
      const start = el("button", "btn", "Start");
      card.appendChild(start);
      card.appendChild(el("div", "hint", "Press Enter to start. A 3-2-1 countdown comes first."));
      screen().innerHTML = ""; screen().appendChild(card);
      start.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      let started = false;
      const go = async () => {
        if (started) return; started = true;
        keyHandler = null;
        const tbl = card.querySelector("table.howto");
        [...card.querySelectorAll("p.text, .btn, .hint")].forEach((n) => n.remove());
        if (tbl && isReal) tbl.classList.add("compact"); else if (tbl) tbl.remove();
        const area = el("div", "", ""); area.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px";
        card.appendChild(area);
        await countdown(area);
        const res = isReal ? await REAL.play(area, name, tier, env) : await GAMES[name](area, tier);
        keyHandler = null; keyUpHandler = null;
        area.innerHTML = "";
        if (tbl) tbl.remove();
        const hh = area.appendChild(el("h2", "", res.win ? "Good job!" : "Failed!")); hh.style.color = res.win ? COL.safe : COL.blood;
        if (res.note) area.appendChild(el("p", "text", esc(res.note)));
        await sleep(1300);
        resolve(res);
      };
      start.addEventListener("click", go);
      keyHandler = (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { go(); return true; } };
    });
  }

  async function countdown(area) {
    const h = el("h2", "", "3");
    h.style.cssText = "font-size:64px;color:" + COL.hazard;
    area.appendChild(h);
    for (const t of ["3", "2", "1", "GO!"]) { h.textContent = t; await sleep(500); }
    h.remove();
  }

  function makeCanvas(area, w, h) {
    const stage = el("div", "stage");
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    c.width = w * dpr; c.height = h * dpr;
    const x = c.getContext("2d"); x.scale(dpr, dpr);
    stage.appendChild(c); area.appendChild(stage);
    return { c, x, w, h };
  }
  function text(x, s, px, py, color, size = 16, font = "IBM Plex Mono", align = "left", weight = "400") {
    x.fillStyle = color; x.font = `${weight} ${size}px "${font}", monospace`; x.textAlign = align; x.textBaseline = "middle"; x.fillText(s, px, py);
  }
  function timeBar(x, w, frac, y = 6) {
    x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(10, y, w - 20, 6);
    x.fillStyle = frac > 0.5 ? COL.hazard : frac > 0.25 ? COL.food : COL.blood;
    x.fillRect(10, y, (w - 20) * Math.max(0, frac), 6);
  }
  function loop(fn) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let last = performance.now();
      function f(now) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
        const r = fn(dt, now);
        if (r !== undefined) resolve(r); else requestAnimationFrame(f);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(f);
    });
  }
  function buttonRow(area, labels) {
    const row = el("div", "controls");
    const bs = labels.map((l) => { const b = el("button", "btn ghost", l); row.appendChild(b); return b; });
    area.appendChild(row);
    return bs;
  }
  function textInput(area, placeholder, digits) {
    const row = el("div", "controls");
    const inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.id = "mg-input-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
    inp.setAttribute("aria-label", placeholder);
    inp.placeholder = placeholder; inp.autocomplete = "off"; inp.spellcheck = false;
    if (digits) { inp.inputMode = "numeric"; inp.style.width = "140px"; }
    row.appendChild(inp); area.appendChild(row);
    setTimeout(() => inp.focus({ preventScroll: true }), 30);
    return inp;
  }

  const GAMES = {};

  // ---- 1. Lock the Door ----
  GAMES["Lock the Door"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const [zone, speed] = { HARD: [3, 44], NORMAL: [5, 30], EASY: [9, 20] }[tier];
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 640, 220);
    const [lockBtn] = buttonRow(area, ["LOCK"]);
    let wins = 0, losses = 0;
    for (let rnd = 1; rnd <= 3 && wins < 2 && losses < 2; rnd++) {
      const W = 44, start = rint(8, W - zone - 2);
      let pos = 0, dir = 1, passes = 0, pressed = false;
      const press = () => { pressed = true; };
      lockBtn.onclick = press;
      keyHandler = (e) => { if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") { press(); return true; } };
      const ok = await loop((dt, now) => {
        pos += dir * speed * dt;
        if (pos >= W - 1) { pos = W - 1; dir = -1; passes++; } else if (pos <= 0) { pos = 0; dir = 1; passes++; }
        x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        text(x, `ROUND ${rnd}/3   LOCKED ${wins}`, 16, 22, COL.frost, 15);
        const shake = Math.sin(now / 60) * 3;
        x.fillStyle = "#3a2a1c"; x.fillRect(w - 120 + shake, 40, 80, 150);
        text(x, "BANG!", w - 80 + shake, 30, COL.blood, 15, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600");
        const cell = 10, bx = 40, by = 120;
        for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) { x.fillStyle = i >= start && i < start + zone ? COL.safe : "#24323f"; x.fillRect(bx + i * cell, by, cell - 1, 22); }
        x.fillStyle = COL.hazard; x.fillRect(bx + Math.floor(pos) * cell - 1, by - 14, cell + 1, 50);
        if (pressed) return pos >= start && pos < start + zone;
        if (passes >= 4) return false;
      });
      ok ? wins++ : losses++;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      text(x, ok ? "LOCKED!" : "MISSED! The door cracks open...", w / 2, h / 2, ok ? COL.safe : COL.blood, 28, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
      await sleep(800);
    }
    return { win: wins >= 2 };
  };

  // ---- 2. Escape the Horde ----
  GAMES["Escape the Horde"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const [nz, step, limit] = { HARD: [5, 0.33, 25], NORMAL: [3, 0.5, 30], EASY: [2, 0.8, 40] }[tier];
    const GW = 40, GH = 14, CS = 16;
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, GW * CS, GH * CS + 24);
    let grid, p, ex;
    const pathOK = (a, b) => { const seen = new Set([a + ""]), todo = [a]; while (todo.length) { const [y, xx] = todo.pop(); if (y === b[0] && xx === b[1]) return true; for (const [dy, dx] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const ny = y + dy, nx = xx + dx; if (ny >= 0 && ny < GH && nx >= 0 && nx < GW && grid[ny][nx] !== "#" && !seen.has(ny + "," + nx)) { seen.add(ny + "," + nx); todo.push([ny, nx]); } } } return false; };
    do {
      grid = Array.from({ length: GH }, () => Array.from({ length: GW }, () => (Math.random() < 0.18 ? "#" : " ")));
      p = [GH >> 1, 1]; ex = [rint(1, GH - 2), GW - 2];
      grid[p[0]][p[1]] = " "; grid[ex[0]][ex[1]] = " ";
    } while (!pathOK(p, ex));
    let zs = [];
    while (zs.length < nz) { const z = [rint(0, GH - 1), rint(GW / 3 | 0, GW - 4)]; if (grid[z[0]][z[1]] === " " && !(z[0] === ex[0] && z[1] === ex[1]) && !zs.some((q) => q[0] === z[0] && q[1] === z[1])) zs.push(z); }
    const move = (dy, dx) => { const ny = p[0] + dy, nx = p[1] + dx; if (ny >= 0 && ny < GH && nx >= 0 && nx < GW && grid[ny][nx] !== "#") p = [ny, nx]; };
    const pad = el("div", "pad", `<span class="sp"></span><button aria-label="Up">&#9650;</button><span class="sp"></span><button aria-label="Left">&#9664;</button><button aria-label="Down">&#9660;</button><button aria-label="Right">&#9654;</button>`);
    area.appendChild(pad);
    const [, up, , left, down, right] = pad.children;
    up.onclick = () => move(-1, 0); down.onclick = () => move(1, 0); left.onclick = () => move(0, -1); right.onclick = () => move(0, 1);
    const keys = { ArrowUp: [-1, 0], ArrowDown: [1, 0], ArrowLeft: [0, -1], ArrowRight: [0, 1], w: [-1, 0], s: [1, 0], a: [0, -1], d: [0, 1] };
    keyHandler = (e) => { const k = keys[e.key] || keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]; if (k) { move(...k); return true; } };
    const zstep = (z, taken) => {
      const opts = [];
      for (const [dy, dx] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) {
        const ny = z[0] + dy, nx = z[1] + dx;
        if (ny >= 0 && ny < GH && nx >= 0 && nx < GW && grid[ny][nx] !== "#" && (!taken.has(ny + "," + nx) || (ny === p[0] && nx === p[1])))
          opts.push([Math.abs(ny - p[0]) + Math.abs(nx - p[1]) + Math.random() * 0.5, [ny, nx]]);
      }
      if (!opts.length) return z;
      if (Math.random() < 0.2) return opts[rint(0, opts.length - 1)][1];
      return opts.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])[0][1];
    };
    let t = 0, zt = 0;
    const win = await loop((dt) => {
      t += dt; zt += dt;
      if (p[0] === ex[0] && p[1] === ex[1]) return true;
      if (zt >= step) { zt = 0; const taken = new Set(zs.map((z) => z + "")); zs = zs.map((z) => zstep(z, taken)); }
      if (zs.some((z) => z[0] === p[0] && z[1] === p[1]) || t > limit) return false;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      timeBar(x, w, 1 - t / limit, 8);
      for (let y = 0; y < GH; y++) for (let xx = 0; xx < GW; xx++) if (grid[y][xx] === "#") { x.fillStyle = "#2c4258"; x.fillRect(xx * CS + 1, 24 + y * CS + 1, CS - 2, CS - 2); }
      text(x, "E", ex[1] * CS + CS / 2, 24 + ex[0] * CS + CS / 2, COL.safe, 15, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600");
      zs.forEach((z) => text(x, "Z", z[1] * CS + CS / 2, 24 + z[0] * CS + CS / 2, COL.blood, 15, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600"));
      x.fillStyle = COL.hazard; x.beginPath(); x.arc(p[1] * CS + CS / 2, 24 + p[0] * CS + CS / 2, 6, 0, 7); x.fill();
    });
    return { win, note: win ? "You slipped out of the lot!" : "They caught up to you..." };
  };

  // ---- 3. Dodge the Wrecks ----
  GAMES["Dodge the Wrecks"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const [tick, dur, lives] = { HARD: [0.09, 20, 1], NORMAL: [0.14, 16, 2], EASY: [0.2, 12, 3] }[tier];
    const ROWS = 16, CAR = 14;
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 420, 360);
    const [lb, rb] = buttonRow(area, ["◀ Left", "Right ▶"]);
    let lane = 1, objs = [], hits = 0, bottles = 0, cool = 0, t = 0, acc = 0;
    const collide = () => { objs = objs.filter((o) => { if (o.r === CAR && o.l === lane) { o.k === "W" ? bottles++ : hits++; return false; } return true; }); };
    const steer = (d) => { lane = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, lane + d)); collide(); };
    lb.onclick = () => steer(-1); rb.onclick = () => steer(1);
    keyHandler = (e) => { const k = e.key.toLowerCase(); if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") { steer(-1); return true; } if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") { steer(1); return true; } };
    const laneX = (l) => 60 + l * 100 + 50, rowY = (r) => 30 + r * 20;
    const win = await loop((dt) => {
      t += dt; acc += dt;
      while (acc >= tick) {
        acc -= tick;
        objs.forEach((o) => o.r++); collide(); objs = objs.filter((o) => o.r <= CAR);
        if (--cool <= 0) {
          const ls = shuffle([0, 1, 2]);
          ls.slice(0, Math.random() < 0.65 ? 1 : 2).forEach((l) => objs.push({ r: 0, l, k: Math.random() < 0.66 ? "#" : "Z" }));
          if (Math.random() < 0.3) objs.push({ r: 0, l: ls[2], k: "W" });
          cool = rint(3, 5);
        }
      }
      if (hits >= lives) return false;
      if (t >= dur) return true;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      timeBar(x, w, 1 - t / dur, 6);
      text(x, `HITS ${hits}/${lives}   WATER ${bottles}`, 14, 22, COL.frost, 13);
      x.fillStyle = "#151f29"; x.fillRect(60, 30, 300, 330);
      x.strokeStyle = COL.line; x.setLineDash([10, 12]); x.lineDashOffset = -t * 120;
      [160, 260].forEach((lx) => { x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(lx, 30); x.lineTo(lx, 360); x.stroke(); });
      x.setLineDash([]);
      objs.forEach((o) => {
        if (o.k === "#") { x.fillStyle = "#5c6f82"; x.fillRect(laneX(o.l) - 18, rowY(o.r) - 8, 36, 16); }
        else text(x, o.k, laneX(o.l), rowY(o.r), o.k === "Z" ? COL.blood : COL.ice, 20, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600");
      });
      x.fillStyle = COL.hazard; x.fillRect(laneX(lane) - 14, rowY(CAR) - 12, 28, 24);
      x.fillStyle = "#fff6c4"; x.fillRect(laneX(lane) - 12, rowY(CAR) - 14, 6, 4); x.fillRect(laneX(lane) + 6, rowY(CAR) - 14, 6, 4);
    });
    return { win, bonus: bottles ? { water: 5 * bottles } : {}, note: bottles ? `You grabbed ${bottles} water bottle(s).` : "" };
  };

  // ---- 4. Barricade the Door ----
  const WORDS = ["BOARD", "NAIL", "BRACE", "LOCK", "CHAIN", "WEDGE", "BOLT", "PLANK", "HAMMER", "SCREW", "BEAM", "DOOR"];
  GAMES["Barricade the Door"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const [fall, allowed] = { HARD: [0.55, 0], NORMAL: [0.8, 1], EASY: [1.15, 2] }[tier];
    const need = 6, ROWS = 13;
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 640, 320);
    const inp = textInput(area, "Type a word");
    let active = [], done = 0, breaches = 0, ft = 0, next = 0, t = 0;
    inp.addEventListener("input", () => {
      const v = inp.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "");
      const hit = active.find((a) => a.word === v);
      if (hit) { active = active.filter((a) => a !== hit); done++; inp.value = ""; }
    });
    keyHandler = (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { inp.value = ""; return true; } };
    const win = await loop((dt) => {
      t += dt; ft += dt;
      if (ft >= fall) { ft = 0; active.forEach((a) => a.row++); const lost = active.filter((a) => a.row >= ROWS); breaches += lost.length; active = active.filter((a) => a.row < ROWS); }
      if (t >= next && active.length < 3) {
        const used = active.map((a) => a.word);
        active.push({ word: shuffle(WORDS.filter((wd) => !used.includes(wd)))[0], row: 0, col: rint(20, 520) });
        next = t + fall * (3 + Math.random() * 2);
      }
      if (done >= need) return true;
      if (breaches > allowed) return false;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      text(x, `NAILED ${done}/${need}   BREACHES ${breaches}/${allowed}`, 14, 16, COL.frost, 13);
      const typed = inp.value.toUpperCase();
      active.forEach((a) => {
        const y = 36 + a.row * 20, near = a.row >= ROWS - 4;
        text(x, a.word, a.col, y, near ? COL.blood : COL.hazard, 22, "Big Shoulders Display", "left", "800");
        if (typed && a.word.startsWith(typed)) { x.font = '800 22px "Big Shoulders Display", sans-serif'; text(x, typed, a.col, y, COL.safe, 22, "Big Shoulders Display", "left", "800"); }
      });
      x.fillStyle = "#3a2a1c"; x.fillRect(0, h - 24, w, 24);
      text(x, "D O O R", w / 2, h - 12, COL.muted, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
    });
    inp.disabled = true;
    return { win };
  };

  // ---- 5. Safe or Unsafe? ----
  const SAFE_UNSAFE = [
    ["A bulging, swollen can of beans", "U"], ["Snow melted and boiled", "S"], ["Water from a red mine pit lake", "U"],
    ["A sealed bottle of water", "S"], ["A rusty, leaking can of soup", "U"], ["A chocolate bar from a gas station", "S"],
    ["Lake water you didn't boil", "U"], ["A jar of honey from a pantry", "S"], ["Raw meat from a truck that thawed days ago", "U"],
    ["A sealed pack of crackers", "S"], ["Eating snow instead of melting it first", "U"], ["Water from a home's water heater tank", "S"],
  ];
  GAMES["Safe or Unsafe?"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const speed = { HARD: 13, NORMAL: 8, EASY: 5 }[tier], TRACK = 46;
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 640, 200);
    const [sb, ub] = buttonRow(area, ["S · Safe", "U · Unsafe"]);
    let right = 0;
    const items = shuffle(SAFE_UNSAFE.slice()).slice(0, 5);
    for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) {
      const [label, truth] = items[n];
      let pos = TRACK, ans = null;
      sb.onclick = () => (ans = "S"); ub.onclick = () => (ans = "U");
      keyHandler = (e) => { const k = e.key.toUpperCase(); if (k === "S" || k === "U") { ans = k; return true; } };
      await loop((dt) => {
        pos -= speed * dt;
        if (!ans && pos <= 0) ans = "-";
        x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        text(x, `ITEM ${n + 1}/5   CORRECT ${right}`, 14, 16, COL.frost, 13);
        text(x, label, w / 2, 60, COL.hazard, 22, "Barlow", "center", "700");
        x.fillStyle = "#24323f"; x.fillRect(70, 140, 540, 8);
        x.fillStyle = "#3a2a1c"; x.fillRect(14, 112, 50, 40); text(x, "PACK", 39, 132, COL.muted, 11, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
        const bx = 70 + (Math.max(0, pos) / TRACK) * 520;
        x.fillStyle = COL.ice; x.fillRect(bx, 114, 26, 26); text(x, "?", bx + 13, 127, COL.bg, 16, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600");
        if (ans) return true;
      });
      const ok = ans === truth;
      right += ok;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      text(x, (ok ? "Correct! " : ans === "-" ? "Too slow! " : "Wrong! ") + `It's ${truth === "S" ? "SAFE" : "UNSAFE"}.`, w / 2, h / 2, ok ? COL.safe : COL.blood, 24, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
      await sleep(900);
    }
    return { win: right >= 4, note: `${right} of 5 correct.` };
  };

  // ---- 6. Count the Infected ----
  GAMES["Count the Infected"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const speed = { HARD: 26, NORMAL: 17, EASY: 10 }[tier];
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 640, 160);
    for (let rnd = 1; rnd <= 2; rnd++) {
      const nz = rint(7, 14), nh = rint(4, 8), LEN = 70, WIDTH = 50;
      const spots = shuffle(Array.from({ length: 3 * (LEN / 2) }, (_, i) => [i % 3, 2 * Math.floor(i / 3)])).slice(0, nz + nh);   // every other column, so letters never touch
      const crowd = spots.map((s, i) => ({ r: s[0], c: s[1], k: i < nz ? "Z" : "H" }));
      let off = -WIDTH;
      await loop((dt) => {
        off += speed * dt;
        x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        text(x, `ROUND ${rnd}/2`, 14, 14, COL.frost, 13);
        x.fillStyle = "#24323f"; x.fillRect(0, 34, w, 2); x.fillRect(0, 138, w, 2);
        crowd.forEach((m) => { const sx = m.c - off; if (sx >= 0 && sx < WIDTH) text(x, m.k, w - 20 - sx * 12, 60 + m.r * 30, m.k === "Z" ? COL.blood : COL.safe, 22, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600"); });
        if (off >= LEN) return true;
      });
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      text(x, "How many infected (Z)?", w / 2, h / 2, COL.hazard, 24, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
      const inp = textInput(area, "Count + Enter", true);
      const guess = await new Promise((res) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => res(-1), 15000);
        keyHandler = (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { clearTimeout(timer); res(parseInt(inp.value, 10)); return true; } };
      });
      inp.parentNode.remove();
      const ok = Math.abs(guess - nz) <= 2;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      text(x, `There were ${nz}. ${guess === nz ? "Good job! Exactly right." : ok ? `Close enough (you said ${guess}).` : "Not close enough."}`, w / 2, h / 2, ok ? COL.safe : COL.blood, 24, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
      await sleep(1100);
      if (!ok) return { win: false };
    }
    return { win: true };
  };

  // ---- 7. Crack the Supply Locker ----
  GAMES["Crack the Supply Locker"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const [tries, limit] = { HARD: [4, 15], NORMAL: [5, 25], EASY: [6, 45] }[tier];
    const code = rint(1, 20);
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 640, 220);
    const inp = textInput(area, "1-20 + Enter", true);
    const log = [];
    let t = 0, result;
    keyHandler = (e) => {
      if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
      const g = parseInt(inp.value, 10); inp.value = "";
      if (!(g >= 1 && g <= 20)) return true;
      if (g === code) result = true;
      else { log.push(`${g}  ->  ${g < code ? "HIGHER" : "LOWER"}`); if (log.length >= tries) result = false; }
      return true;
    };
    const win = await loop((dt) => {
      t += dt;
      if (result !== undefined) return result;
      if (t > limit) return false;
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      timeBar(x, w, 1 - t / limit, 6);
      const steps = t / limit;
      text(x, "FOOTSTEPS", 14, 30, COL.muted, 12);
      for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { x.fillStyle = i / 20 < steps ? COL.blood : "#24323f"; x.fillRect(110 + i * 24, 24, 18, 12); }
      x.strokeStyle = COL.line; x.strokeRect(24, 60, 140, 140);
      text(x, "[ ? ]", 94, 120, COL.hazard, 28, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600");
      text(x, `Guesses left: ${tries - log.length}`, 94, 170, COL.frost, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
      log.forEach((l, i) => text(x, l, 200, 72 + i * 22, COL.food, 16));
    });
    inp.disabled = true;
    return { win, note: `The code was ${code}.` };
  };

  // ---- 8. Decode the Radio ----
  const RADIO_WORDS = ["SAFE ZONE", "BRIDGE", "CONVOY", "SHELTER", "BLIZZARD", "GATES", "MEDIC", "RESCUE", "WATER", "SUPPLY"];
  GAMES["Decode the Radio"] = async (area, tier) => {
    const [limit, stat] = { HARD: [8, 0.35], NORMAL: [12, 0.2], EASY: [20, 0.1] }[tier];
    const { x, w, h } = makeCanvas(area, 640, 160);
    const inp = textInput(area, "Answer + Enter");
    const words = shuffle(RADIO_WORDS.slice()).slice(0, 2);
    for (let n = 0; n < 2; n++) {
      const word = words[n], plain = word.replace(" ", "");
      let letters;
      do { letters = shuffle(plain.split("")); } while (letters.join("") === plain);
      let t = 0, flick = 0, shown = letters.slice(), entered = null;
      inp.value = "";
      keyHandler = (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { entered = inp.value.toUpperCase().replace(/\s/g, ""); return true; } };
      const ok = await loop((dt) => {
        t += dt; flick += dt;
        if (entered !== null) return entered === plain;
        if (t > limit) return false;
        if (flick > 0.4) { flick = 0; shown = letters.map((ch) => (Math.random() < stat ? "#" : ch)); }
        x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        timeBar(x, w, 1 - t / limit, 6);
        text(x, `WORD ${n + 1}/2`, 14, 26, COL.frost, 13);
        for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { x.fillStyle = `rgba(147,167,183,${Math.random() * 0.25})`; x.fillRect(Math.random() * w, 40 + Math.random() * 110, 2, 2); }
        text(x, shown.join("  "), w / 2, 90, COL.hazard, 30, "IBM Plex Mono", "center", "600");
      });
      x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      text(x, (ok ? "Got it! " : "Lost the signal! ") + `The word was ${word}.`, w / 2, h / 2, ok ? COL.safe : COL.blood, 24, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
      await sleep(1000);
      if (!ok) { inp.disabled = true; return { win: false }; }
    }
    inp.disabled = true;
    return { win: true };
  };

  // test hook: lets an automated test start any mini game directly

  // test hook: lets an automated test start any mini game directly
  window.__ZE_TEST = { playMinigame: (n, t) => { $("title").classList.add("hidden"); $("game").classList.remove("hidden"); return playMinigame(n, t, false, current || new Z.Game(B, "SLC", 1)); } };
  titleScreen();
})();

// Zombie Escape - the 10 realistic, interactive mini games.
// Each game is a list of real-world steps. Some steps are "pick the right next action" cards; others are
// hands-on controls (tap, hold a gauge in the green, stop a timer, tune a dial, rotate a compass, keep a rhythm).
// Real data used: the January NOAA normal temperature (cold hands slow your controls), the station elevation
// (CDC boiling rule: 1 minute, or 3 minutes above 6,500 ft), the local infectious share from the SEIR model
// (mistakes make more noise where more infected are around), and the real coordinates of your route stops
// (compass bearing to the next stop). Everything else is fictional game design.
(function () {
  "use strict";
  window.ZE_REAL = function (H) {
    const { el, esc, makeCanvas, text, COL } = H;
    const shuffle = (a) => { a = a.slice(); for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]]; } return a; };
    const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
    const NOT_YET = { sec: 4, noise: 8, why: "Not yet: that step comes later." };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the run (timer, noise, checklist)
    function makeRun(area, G, tier, env) {
      const lim = env.dev ? null : limitFor(G, tier);
      const st = { noise: 0, t0: performance.now(), penalty: 0, limit: lim, over: null, widget: null, cur: null, msg: "", msgCol: COL.muted, steps: [], k: 0, ended: false };
      const cv = makeCanvas(area, 640, 250);
      const check = el("div", "rg-check"); area.appendChild(check);
      const fb = el("div", "rg-feedback", ""); area.appendChild(fb);
      const cards = el("div", "rg-cards"); area.appendChild(cards);
      st.cv = cv; st.check = check; st.fb = fb; st.cards = cards;
      st.lag = env.coldLag;
      st.say = (m, col) => { fb.textContent = m; fb.style.color = col || COL.frost; };
      st.mistake = (p) => {
        const n = p.noise * (1 + 3 * env.I);
        st.noise = clamp(st.noise + n, 0, 100); st.penalty += p.sec || 0;
        st.say(`Mistake: ${p.why}${p.sec ? ` (−${p.sec} s` : ""}${p.sec ? `, +${Math.round(n)} noise)` : ` (+${Math.round(n)} noise)`}`, COL.blood);
        if (p.fatal) st.end("fatal", p.why);
      };
      st.end = (kind, why) => { if (!st.over) { st.over = kind; st.overWhy = why; if (st.cur) { const c = st.cur; st.cur = null; c(false); } } };
      st.left = () => (st.limit == null ? Infinity : st.limit - (performance.now() - st.t0) / 1000 - st.penalty);
      st.renderCheck = () => {
        if (tier === "HARD") { st.check.innerHTML = `<span class="now">Step ${Math.min(st.k + 1, st.steps.length)} of ${st.steps.length}: no checklist on HARD</span>`; return; }
        st.check.innerHTML = st.steps.map((s, i) => i < st.k ? `<span class="done">✓ ${esc(s.short)}</span>`
          : i === st.k ? `<span class="now">${i + 1}. ${esc(tier === "EASY" ? s.short : "What comes next?")}</span>`
          : tier === "EASY" ? `<span>${i + 1}. ${esc(s.short)}</span>` : "").join("");
      };
      // frame loop: HUD strip + current widget
      const frame = () => {
        if (st.ended) return;
        const { x, w } = cv;
        x.fillStyle = COL.bg; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, cv.h);
        const left = st.left();
        if (st.limit != null) {
          const frac = clamp(left / st.limit, 0, 1);
          x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(10, 8, 300, 10);
          x.fillStyle = frac > 0.5 ? COL.hazard : frac > 0.25 ? COL.food : COL.blood; x.fillRect(10, 8, 300 * frac, 10);
          text(x, `TIME ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(left))} s`, 10, 30, COL.frost, 13);
        } else text(x, "TIME: no limit (developer mode)", 10, 30, COL.muted, 13);
        x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(330, 8, 300, 10);
        x.fillStyle = st.noise < 50 ? COL.ice : st.noise < 80 ? COL.food : COL.blood; x.fillRect(330, 8, 3 * st.noise, 10);
        text(x, `NOISE ${Math.round(st.noise)}/100`, 330, 30, COL.frost, 13);
        text(x, `cold hands ×${(1 - st.lag).toFixed(2)} speed`, 630, 30, COL.muted, 12, "IBM Plex Mono", "right");
        x.fillStyle = "#24323f"; x.fillRect(0, 44, w, 1);
        if (st.widget && st.widget.draw) st.widget.draw(x, w, cv.h);
        else text(x, `Step ${Math.min(st.k + 1, st.steps.length)} of ${st.steps.length}`, w / 2, 145, COL.muted, 20, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
        if (left <= 0) st.end("time", "you ran out of time");
        if (st.noise >= 100) st.end("noise", "the noise drew the infected to you");
        if (!st.over) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      return st;
    }
    function limitFor(G, tier) {
      const m = new RegExp(tier + "\\s+(\\d+)\\s*s").exec(G.tiers || "");
      return m ? +m[1] : { EASY: 120, NORMAL: 90, HARD: 70 }[tier];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ step types
    // pick: choose the right next action from cards (keys 1-5 or click)
    function pick(st, step, laterSteps, env) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.widget = null; st.cur = res;
        const wrong = (step.wrong || []).map((w) => Object.assign({ ok: false }, w));
        const later = shuffle(laterSteps.filter((s) => s.kind === "pick")).slice(0, Math.max(0, 3 - wrong.length)).map((s) => Object.assign({ ok: false, label: s.label }, NOT_YET));
        const opts = shuffle([{ ok: true, label: step.label }].concat(wrong.slice(0, 3), later));
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        st.say(step.prompt || "Pick the right next step.", COL.frost);
        const bs = opts.map((o, i) => {
          const b = el("button", "rg-card", `<span class="k">${i + 1}</span>${esc(o.label)}`);
          b.addEventListener("click", () => choose(i)); st.cards.appendChild(b); return b;
        });
        function choose(i) {
          if (st.cur !== res || bs[i].disabled) return;
          const o = opts[i];
          if (o.ok) { st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.cur = null; st.say("✓ " + (step.done || "Done."), COL.safe); res(true); return; }
          bs[i].disabled = true; bs[i].classList.add("bad");
          st.mistake(o);
        }
        H.setKey((e) => { const i = "12345".indexOf(e.key); if (i >= 0 && i < opts.length) { choose(i); return true; } });
      });
    }
    // tap: press Space / the button N times
    function tap(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res;
        let n = step.n + Math.round(step.n * st.lag);
        const total = n;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        const b = el("button", "btn", step.button || "TAP"); st.cards.appendChild(b);
        st.say(`${step.label} Press SPACE or tap the button ${total} times.`, COL.frost);
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          text(x, step.label, w / 2, 90, COL.frost, 22, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) { x.fillStyle = i < total - n ? COL.safe : "#24323f"; x.fillRect(w / 2 - total * 14 + i * 28, 140, 22, 22); }
          text(x, `${n} left`, w / 2, 200, COL.muted, 16, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
        } };
        const hit = () => { if (st.cur !== res) return; n -= 1; if (n <= 0) { st.cur = null; st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ " + (step.done || "Done."), COL.safe); res(true); } };
        b.addEventListener("click", hit);
        H.setKey((e) => { if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") { hit(); return true; } });
      });
    }
    // hold: hold Space / the button to raise a gauge; keep it in the green until the progress ring fills
    function hold(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res;
        let v = 0, prog = 0, held = false, last = performance.now(), wasHigh = false;
        const lo = step.lo, hi = step.hi, need = step.secs;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        const b = el("button", "btn", step.button || "HOLD"); st.cards.appendChild(b);
        st.say(`${step.label} Hold SPACE (or press and hold the button). Keep the needle inside the GREEN band for ${need} s. Let go to lower it.`, COL.frost);
        const down = (e) => { held = true; if (e) e.preventDefault(); }, up = () => { held = false; };
        b.addEventListener("pointerdown", down); b.addEventListener("pointerup", up); b.addEventListener("pointerleave", up);
        H.setKey((e) => { if (e.key === " ") { held = true; return true; } });
        H.setKeyUp((e) => { if (e.key === " ") { held = false; return true; } });
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
          const speed = 1 - st.lag;
          v = clamp(v + (held ? 55 : -45) * speed * dt, 0, 100);
          if (v >= lo && v <= hi) prog += dt;
          if (v > hi + 8 && !wasHigh && step.tooHigh) { wasHigh = true; st.mistake(step.tooHigh); }
          if (v < hi) wasHigh = false;
          const gx = 120, gy = 60, gw = 400, gh = 26;
          text(x, step.label, w / 2, 80 - 20, COL.frost, 18, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(gx, gy + 30, gw, gh);
          x.fillStyle = "#1f5a39"; x.fillRect(gx + gw * lo / 100, gy + 30, gw * (hi - lo) / 100, gh);
          x.fillStyle = COL.frost; x.fillRect(gx + gw * v / 100 - 2, gy + 24, 4, gh + 12);
          text(x, step.lowWord || "too little", gx, gy + 76, COL.muted, 12); text(x, step.highWord || "too much", gx + gw, gy + 76, COL.muted, 12, "IBM Plex Mono", "right");
          x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(gx, 190, gw, 12); x.fillStyle = COL.safe; x.fillRect(gx, 190, gw * Math.min(1, prog / need), 12);
          text(x, `in the green: ${prog.toFixed(1)} / ${need} s`, w / 2, 220, COL.muted, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
          if (prog >= need && st.cur === res) { st.cur = null; st.widget = null; H.setKeyUp(null); st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ " + (step.done || "Done."), COL.safe); res(true); }
        } };
      });
    }
    // crank: hold to crank the starter in short bursts; a burst longer than maxBurst drains the battery
    function crank(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res;
        let held = false, burst = 0, prog = 0, last = performance.now();
        const need = step.secs;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        const b = el("button", "btn", "CRANK"); st.cards.appendChild(b);
        st.say(`Hold SPACE (or the button) to crank. Crank in bursts of under ${step.maxBurst} s, then let go to rest. The engine catches after ${need.toFixed(1)} s of cranking in total.`, COL.frost);
        b.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { held = true; e.preventDefault(); }); b.addEventListener("pointerup", () => (held = false)); b.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => (held = false));
        H.setKey((e) => { if (e.key === " ") { held = true; return true; } });
        H.setKeyUp((e) => { if (e.key === " ") { held = false; return true; } });
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
          if (held) { burst += dt; prog += dt * (1 - st.lag * 0.5); } else burst = 0;
          if (burst > step.maxBurst) { burst = 0; held = false; prog = Math.max(0, prog - need * 0.5); st.mistake({ sec: 6, noise: 10, why: "you cranked too long and drained the battery a little" }); }
          text(x, "Dash lights", w / 2, 66, COL.muted, 14, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { x.fillStyle = prog / need > i / 5 ? COL.safe : "#24323f"; x.beginPath(); x.arc(w / 2 - 100 + i * 50, 100, 14, 0, 7); x.fill(); }
          x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(120, 150, 400, 12); x.fillStyle = burst > step.maxBurst * 0.7 ? COL.blood : COL.hazard; x.fillRect(120, 150, 400 * burst / step.maxBurst, 12);
          text(x, `this burst ${burst.toFixed(1)} / ${step.maxBurst} s`, w / 2, 180, COL.muted, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
          text(x, `cranked ${prog.toFixed(1)} / ${need.toFixed(1)} s${step.coldNote || ""}`, w / 2, 210, COL.frost, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
          if (prog >= need && st.cur === res) { st.cur = null; st.widget = null; H.setKeyUp(null); st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ The engine catches!", COL.safe); res(true); }
        } };
      });
    }
    // stop: a value climbs; press Space / STOP inside the target window
    function stop(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res;
        let v = 0, running = !step.needStart, last = performance.now(), paused = 0;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        const b = el("button", "btn", step.needStart ? "START" : "STOP"); st.cards.appendChild(b);
        st.say(step.label, COL.frost);
        const press = () => {
          if (st.cur !== res) return;
          if (!running) { running = true; b.textContent = "STOP"; return; }
          running = false;
          if (v < step.lo) { if (step.early) { st.mistake(step.early); if (st.over) return; } v = 0; running = !step.needStart; b.textContent = step.needStart ? "START" : "STOP"; st.say("Try again: " + step.label, COL.food); return; }
          if (v > step.hi) { if (step.late) { st.mistake(step.late); if (st.over) return; } }
          st.cur = null; st.widget = null; st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ " + (step.done || "Done."), COL.safe); res(true);
        };
        b.addEventListener("click", press);
        H.setKey((e) => { if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") { press(); return true; } });
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
          if (running) {
            if (step.sputter && paused <= 0 && Math.random() < dt * 0.4) paused = 0.8;
            if (paused > 0) paused -= dt; else v += step.rate * dt;
          }
          if (v > step.max) { v = step.max; if (step.over) { st.mistake(step.over); if (!st.over) { v = 0; running = !step.needStart; b.textContent = step.needStart ? "START" : "STOP"; } } }
          text(x, step.title, w / 2, 66, COL.frost, 18, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          const gx = 70, gw = 500;
          x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(gx, 100, gw, 30);
          x.fillStyle = "#1f5a39"; x.fillRect(gx + gw * step.lo / step.max, 100, gw * (step.hi - step.lo) / step.max, 30);
          x.fillStyle = COL.hazard; x.fillRect(gx, 104, gw * v / step.max, 22);
          text(x, step.show(v), w / 2, 165, COL.frost, 30, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          text(x, paused > 0 ? "the stove sputters… the boil stops" : step.hint || "", w / 2, 205, paused > 0 ? COL.blood : COL.muted, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
        } };
      });
    }
    // tune: LEFT/RIGHT (or the slider) to find a hidden target; hold inside the band for 1.5 s
    function tune(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res;
        let v = step.start, target = step.target, inside = 0, last = performance.now(), dir = 0;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        const row = el("div", "controls");
        const L = el("button", "btn ghost", "◀"), R = el("button", "btn ghost", "▶");
        const sl = document.createElement("input"); sl.type = "range"; sl.min = step.min; sl.max = step.max; sl.step = (step.max - step.min) / 1000; sl.value = v; sl.className = "rg-slider"; sl.setAttribute("aria-label", step.title);
        row.append(L, sl, R); st.cards.appendChild(row);
        st.say(step.label + " Use LEFT/RIGHT arrows, the ◀ ▶ buttons or the slider. Stop when it is clear and hold still for 1.5 s.", COL.frost);
        sl.addEventListener("input", () => (v = +sl.value));
        const hd = (d) => () => (dir = d);
        [[L, -1], [R, 1]].forEach(([b, d]) => { b.addEventListener("pointerdown", hd(d)); b.addEventListener("pointerup", hd(0)); b.addEventListener("pointerleave", hd(0)); });
        H.setKey((e) => { if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { dir = -1; return true; } if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { dir = 1; return true; } });
        H.setKeyUp((e) => { if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowRight") { dir = 0; return true; } });
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
          const range = step.max - step.min;
          v = step.wrap ? ((v - step.min + dir * range * 0.18 * (1 - st.lag) * dt) % range + range) % range + step.min : clamp(v + dir * range * 0.18 * (1 - st.lag) * dt, step.min, step.max);
          sl.value = v;
          if (step.drift) target = clamp(target + Math.sin(now / 900) * range * 0.02 * dt, step.min, step.max);
          let d = Math.abs(v - target); if (step.wrap) d = Math.min(d, range - d);
          const clear = clamp(1 - d / (range * 0.25), 0, 1);
          if (d <= step.tol) inside += dt; else inside = 0;
          text(x, step.title, w / 2, 62, COL.frost, 18, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          if (step.draw) step.draw(x, w, v, clear);
          else {
            for (let i = 0; i < 260 * (1 - clear); i++) { x.fillStyle = `rgba(230,238,243,${Math.random() * 0.4})`; x.fillRect(Math.random() * w, 80 + Math.random() * 90, 2, 2); }
            text(x, step.show(v), w / 2, 125, COL.frost, 34, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          }
          x.fillStyle = "#0b121a"; x.fillRect(120, 190, 400, 10); x.fillStyle = clear > 0.9 ? COL.safe : COL.ice; x.fillRect(120, 190, 400 * clear, 10);
          text(x, `${step.clearWord || "signal"} ${Math.round(clear * 100)}%  ·  holding ${Math.min(1.5, inside).toFixed(1)} / 1.5 s`, w / 2, 220, COL.muted, 13, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
          if (inside >= 1.5 && st.cur === res) { st.cur = null; st.widget = null; H.setKeyUp(null); st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ " + (step.done || "Locked in."), COL.safe); res(true); }
        } };
      });
    }
    // rhythm: a ring pulses; press Space / the button while it is inside the green ring
    function rhythm(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res;
        let hits = 0, t = 0, last = performance.now(), misses = 0, flash = 0, used = false;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        const b = el("button", "btn", step.button || "PRESS"); st.cards.appendChild(b);
        st.say(`${step.label} Press SPACE (or the button) when the white ring is inside the green ring. ${step.hits} good presses needed.`, COL.frost);
        const press = () => {
          if (st.cur !== res) return;
          const ph = (t % step.period) / step.period;
          if (ph > 0.72 && ph < 0.95 && !used) { hits += 1; used = true; misses = 0; flash = 0.2; }
          else { misses += 1; if (misses >= 2) { misses = 0; st.mistake(step.miss); } }
          if (hits >= step.hits) { st.cur = null; st.widget = null; st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ " + (step.done || "Done."), COL.safe); res(true); }
        };
        b.addEventListener("click", press);
        H.setKey((e) => { if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") { press(); return true; } });
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
          const before = t % step.period; t += dt; if (t % step.period < before) used = false;
          const ph = (t % step.period) / step.period;
          text(x, step.title, w / 2, 62, COL.frost, 18, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          x.strokeStyle = "#1f5a39"; x.lineWidth = 14; x.beginPath(); x.arc(w / 2, 145, 60 * 0.835, 0, 7); x.stroke();
          x.strokeStyle = flash > 0 ? COL.safe : COL.frost; x.lineWidth = 3; x.beginPath(); x.arc(w / 2, 145, 60 * ph + 2, 0, 7); x.stroke();
          flash -= dt;
          text(x, `${hits} / ${step.hits}`, w / 2 + 150, 145, COL.frost, 26, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
        } };
      });
    }
    // inspect: tap every sign to see what it shows
    function inspect(st, step) {
      return new Promise((res) => {
        st.cur = res; st.widget = null;
        st.cards.innerHTML = "";
        st.say(step.label + " Tap each one to check it.", COL.frost);
        let left = step.items.length;
        const found = [];
        st.widget = { draw(x, w) {
          text(x, step.title, w / 2, 62, COL.frost, 18, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
          found.forEach((f, i) => text(x, f, w / 2, 100 + i * 30, COL.food, 16, "IBM Plex Mono", "center"));
        } };
        const bs = step.items.map(([name, what], i) => {
          const b = el("button", "rg-card", `<span class="k">${i + 1}</span>Check ${esc(name)}`);
          b.addEventListener("click", () => look(i)); st.cards.appendChild(b); return b;
        });
        function look(i) {
          if (st.cur !== res || bs[i].disabled) return;
          bs[i].disabled = true; found.push(`${step.items[i][0]}: ${step.items[i][1]}`); left -= 1;
          if (!left) { setTimeout(() => { if (st.cur !== res) return; st.cur = null; st.widget = null; st.cards.innerHTML = ""; st.say("✓ " + step.done, COL.safe); res(true); }, 900); }
        }
        H.setKey((e) => { const i = "12345".indexOf(e.key); if (i >= 0 && i < bs.length) { look(i); return true; } });
      });
    }
    const RUNNERS = { pick, tap, hold, crank, stop, tune, rhythm, inspect };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the 10 games
    const mmss = (s) => `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(s % 60)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    const P = (label, wrong, extra) => Object.assign({ kind: "pick", label, wrong: wrong || [] }, extra || {});
    const GAMES = {
      "Change a Flat in the Dark": (tier, env) => [
        P("Wedge the wheel opposite the flat", [{ label: "Jack the car up first", why: "the wheel spins in the air when you try to loosen the nuts", sec: 8, noise: 20 }], { short: "Wedge the opposite wheel" }),
        P("Loosen the lug nuts a half turn while the tire is on the ground", [], { short: "Loosen nuts (tire down)" }),
        { kind: "tap", label: tier === "HARD" ? "One lug nut is seized. Work the wrench." : "Break each lug nut loose.", n: tier === "HARD" ? 14 : 8, button: "TURN WRENCH", done: "Nuts loosened.", short: "Turn the wrench" },
        P("Place the jack at the frame point behind the front wheel", [{ label: "Place the jack under the plastic bumper", why: "the bumper cracks and the car drops", sec: 0, noise: 30, fatal: true }], { short: "Jack at the frame point" }),
        { kind: "hold", label: "Hold the flashlight steady while you swap the tire.", lo: 45, hi: 75, secs: tier === "HARD" ? 4 : 3, button: "HOLD LIGHT", lowWord: "too dark", highWord: "beam everywhere", done: "Tire swapped.", short: "Swap the tire" },
        P("Hand-tighten, lower the car, then tighten in a star pattern", [{ label: "Tighten each nut fully, one by one, around the circle", why: "the wheel seats crooked; you redo it", sec: 8, noise: 8 }], { short: "Lower, star-pattern tighten" }),
      ],
      "Jump-Start a Dead Battery": (tier, env) => {
        const lab = tier === "EASY" ? " (red, marked +)" : "";
        const s = [];

    function compass(x, cx, cy, r, ang, label) {
      x.strokeStyle = COL.line; x.lineWidth = 3; x.beginPath(); x.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, 7); x.stroke();
      const a = (ang - 90) * Math.PI / 180;
      x.strokeStyle = COL.blood; x.lineWidth = 4; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(cx, cy); x.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.9, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.9); x.stroke();
      x.strokeStyle = COL.ice; x.lineWidth = 2; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(cx, cy); x.lineTo(cx, cy - r * 0.9); x.stroke();
      text(x, label, cx + r + 50, cy, COL.frost, 22, "Big Shoulders Display", "center", "800");
      text(x, "needle", cx - r - 50, cy - 10, COL.ice, 12, "IBM Plex Mono", "center"); text(x, "map", cx - r - 50, cy + 10, COL.blood, 12, "IBM Plex Mono", "center");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ public
    async function play(area, name, tier, env) {
      const G = env.G, steps = GAMES[name](tier, env);
      const st = makeRun(area, G, tier, env);
      st.steps = steps; st.renderCheck();
      for (let i = 0; i < steps.length && !st.over; i++) {
        st.k = i; st.renderCheck();
        const ok = await RUNNERS[steps[i].kind](st, steps[i], steps.slice(i + 1), env);
        H.setKey(null); H.setKeyUp(null);
        if (!ok || st.over) break;
        st.k = i + 1; st.renderCheck();
      }
      const win = !st.over;
      st.ended = true; st.widget = null; H.setKey(null); H.setKeyUp(null);
      st.cards.innerHTML = "";
      return { win, note: win ? "" : `Failed: ${st.overWhy}.` };
    }
    return { play, names: Object.keys(GAMES), steps: (name, tier, env) => GAMES[name](tier, env) };
  };
})();
